Post : Outreach Support Worker
Contract: Permanent, Part- Time (12.5 hrs per week)
Roster: Mon 08:30 - 15:00 / Fri: 08:30 - 14:30 - Muckross area, Killarney, Co Kerry.
Please note, the above Roster may be subject to change due to the operational requirements of the service*
Outreach Services deliver one to one supports to adults with intellectual disabilities across Kerry.
Outreach provides an individualised, rights based programme tailored to each participant. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting an individual to attend chosen activities in their local community and work towards achieving their identified goals.
Outreach places a strong emphasis on enhancing the quality of life for those we support and operates in line with the HSE New Directions model of care. This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable working alone, self motivated, independent, and confident in their ability to make decisions and solve problems. Experience supporting adults with autism is an advantage.
The Role:
The Support Worker will play a vital role in empowering individuals by planning and setting meaningful goals that address their unique personal, social, recreational, academic, independent living, community integration, training, and supported employment needs.
They will actively guide and support individuals to realise their aspirations, helping them reach identified priorities and achieve greater independence and self sufficiency. They will also advocate for inclusion and active participation in the community, ensuring access to opportunities that promote social and personal growth.
The Support Worker operates within a person centred framework, prioritising each individual’s choices and needs. They will work closely with both internal and external services, fostering a culture of collaboration and partnership, and building strong relationships with families to ensure holistic support.
In addition to supporting adults with intellectual disabilities, the Support Worker will be responsible for maintaining accurate records, completing relevant reports, and ensuring all documentation meets required standards. The role includes providing physical, emotional, psychological, and healthcare support, all while promoting dignity, respect, and personal autonomy.
They will also facilitate life skills development through hobbies, interests, and activities, teaching skills such as budgeting, cooking, communication, and time management to promote greater independence.
The Support Worker will work alongside a range of healthcare professionals to ensure all aspects of care are delivered to the highest standard. Their input will be essential in creating care plans that are responsive to evolving needs, fostering personal growth, wellbeing, and a sense of belonging within the community.
This is a dynamic and rewarding position that requires dedication, a commitment to lifelong learning, and a strong passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of those supported.
Essential Criteria:
QQI Level 5 in Healthcare Support. Equivalent qualifications to Healthcare support will be considered, with a minimum of 1 years relevant experience working with Adults with an Intellectual Disability.
Applications will also be considered from candidates who have successfully completed at least 1 year of their Nursing or Social Care degree.
A passion for promoting and empowering those you support.
An excellent knowledge of New Directions, Disability Act 2005, Health & Safety Legislation, Data Protection, & GDPR.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to engage effectively with individuals, families, colleagues, managers, and senior team members.
Ability to document and report accurately and professionally.
Ability to plan, coordinate, and document daily activities and individualised care plans.
Ability to maintain accurate digital records and complete reports in compliance with GDPR.
Strong time management skills to balance multiple responsibilities effectively.
A deep understanding of rights based and person centred approaches to support and advocacy.
Applicants must hold a full driver’s licence, have proven driving experience, and be willing to drive Association vehicles. Regarding use of own vehicle for work purposes, applicants must ensure it is roadworthy and covered by valid business insurance (or be willing to obtain business use insurance).
Applicants must have the necessary authorisation to work in Ireland and will be asked to provide supporting documentation during the recruitment process.
Highly Desirable Criteria:
Experience of working in a care delivery capacity, preferably within a disability service.
Experience of liaising with statutory and other voluntary agencies.
Familiarity with basic IT skills for reporting, record keeping, and communication.
Employee Benefits: Sick Pay Scheme, Paid Maternity Leave, Flexible Working, Employee Assistance Programme, Pension Scheme, Parking ( Site Dependent), Generous Annual Leave, Access to income continuance scheme, Discounted Health Insurance and Access to training.
(A panel may be formed from which future vacancies for the Outreach service may be filled up to the 31st of March 2027).

Failure to provide this information, along with a satisfactorily completed verification of service form before an agreed start date, will result in placement at Point 1 of the applicable scale. Incremental credit will only be applied from the date correct documents are submitted.*
Your CV and application must be written independently and accurately reflecting your own experience, skills, and competencies. The use of AI or automated tools to complete any part is not permitted.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant
jobs.desc:

Location: Cork
Join Musgrave – A Legacy of Innovation, Community, and Excellence
Musgrave is one of Europe’s most successful family-owned businesses, with a rich 150-year legacy in food and brand innovation. We're proud to serve communities across Ireland and Spain, feeding one in three people every day through 19 iconic brands like SuperValu, Centra, Mace, Frank and Honest, and Musgrave MarketPlace. As we continue our journey toward becoming Ireland’s most trusted and sustainable business, we have an exciting opportunity for a successful candidate to join our Financal Control team.
Role Purpose
The Senior Financial Accountant – Northern Ireland is a senior Financial Control role responsible for the financial accounting, control, compliance and reporting agenda supporting the Musgrave Northern Ireland business.
The role owns cashflow forecasting, capital expenditure and depreciation reporting, quarterly HMRC compliance, intercompany governance in an outsourced operating model, and control and assurance reporting including MACSAC.
Working closely with NI Finance, Group Financial Control, Tax, Treasury, the outsourced service provider and External Audit, the role provides accurate reporting, independent challenge and assurance over the NI control environment, while driving standardisation and continuous improvement in line with the Group Financial Control agenda.
What you'll be doing:
Cashflow, Capital Expenditure & Depreciation
Own the preparation, review and challenge of short and medium-term cashflow forecasting for the NI business, including variance analysis against actuals. Including working capital reviews.
Forecast and report capital expenditure and the associated depreciation profile, working with business owners to validate phasing, spend and asset readiness.
Ensure capital spend is appropriately authorised, correctly capitalised and depreciated in line with Group accounting policy.
Provide insight to NI and Group leadership on cash, capex and depreciation trends, risks and opportunities.
Tax & Statutory Compliance (HMRC)
Prepare, review and submit quarterly HMRC returns for the NI entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness and timely filing.
Coordinate the quarterly VAT product file review process, engaging commercial and master data stakeholders to confirm correct VAT treatment and resolve exceptions.
Maintain robust documentation and audit trail supporting all returns and product file decisions.
Work with the Group Tax team on technical queries, legislative change and HMRC correspondence.
Intercompany Oversight & Outsourced Model Governance
Provide oversight and governance of intercompany transactions, balances, reconciliations and settlement across NI and Group entities.
Act as the retained control owner over activities performed by the outsourced service provider, reviewing outputs rather than performing the underlying processing.
Monitor service performance, SLA delivery and escalations, ensuring issues are resolved and root causes addressed.
Ensure intercompany balances are agreed, eliminated correctly on consolidation and supported by clear documentation.
Controls, Assurance & Reporting
Own MACSAC reporting for the NI business, including self-assessment, evidence, scoring and remediation of control gaps.
Ensure period-end controls, balance sheet reconciliations and journals meet Group standards and are reviewed on a timely basis.
Support internal and external audit requests and ensure timely closure of audit and management actions.
Prepare clear control and financial reporting updates for Financial Control forums and senior leadership.
Additional Financial Accounting Activity
Support the acquisition agenda within Retail.
Support lease accounting, including new leases, modifications and related disclosures.
Support insurance accounting, renewals data and related cost allocation.
Review employee expenses for compliance with policy, VAT treatment and control standards.
Support statutory financial statements preparation and audit for the NI entities.
Support wider Group Financial Control, transformation and process improvement initiatives as required.
What we are looking for:
Essential
Qualified Chartered Accountant (or equivalent).
3+ years post-qualified experience in financial accounting, financial control or audit.
Strong technical accounting knowledge and understanding of internal controls and financial governance.
Experience of cashflow forecasting, fixed assets and capital expenditure reporting.
Practical VAT and indirect tax compliance experience, ideally including HMRC filings.
Strong analytical, reconciliation and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to work with and challenge an outsourced service provider in a retained oversight model.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across finance and non-finance audiences.
Desirable
Experience in retail, wholesale or FMCG.
Knowledge of UK and Irish tax and statutory reporting requirements.
Experience with Oracle, Onspring, Power BI or similar finance and control systems.
Why Musgrave:
Career Development: With a commitment to your personal and professional growth, Musgrave offers numerous opportunities for advancement and learning.
Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a passionate team, where your contributions will make a significant impact
Innovation Focus: Be part of a company that values forward-thinking solutions
Community Focus: Be part of a company that truly values its communities and strives to make a positive impact.
Be Part of a Legacy: Join a company with a long-standing commitment to community and innovation.
Ready to make an impact?
Apply now and be part of a forward-thinking company that values your expertise and vision.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Graduate Programme 2026
jobs.desc:
Interested in smart manufacturing? Want to influence the power grid of the future? Tackle climate change? Launch your career with NeoDyne and open a world of opportunities!
Overview
NeoDyne is a leading engineering company specialising in industrial automation, digital manufacturing, and electrical engineering solutions. With a strong presence across multiple sectors, including Life Sciences, Food & Beverage, and Energy, NeoDyne delivers leading-edge solutions that drive efficiency, safety, and performance for its customers worldwide.
We develop high-availability automation and electrical systems for mission-critical industries, including pharmaceutical manufacturing, data centres, and energy infrastructure, ensuring continuous operation and compliance. We additionally integrate emerging technologies to enhance control, scalability, and operational insight. Our expertise also extends to power generation, natural gas transmission, and high-voltage system design, delivering robust solutions that strengthen critical infrastructure.
With a team of 200+ skilled engineers, our expertise spans the entire project lifecycle, from design and implementation to commissioning and operations. From our offices in Ireland, the UK, Romania, and the US, we operate on a global scale, combining technical expertise with local delivery. We support customers across Europe, North America, and Asia, delivering tailored engineering services that drive long-term success.
Position Summary
NeoDyne are recruiting a
Graduate Mechanical Engineer
to join our expanding engineering teams. Our graduate programme is all about learning new and developing your existing skills. Over a two-year period, you will be placed in projects where you get to do meaningful work and contribute to the business.
This Graduate opportunity is offered as a full-time permanent contract, based at our
Cork Office
, with an excellent salary and benefits package. If successful, you will enjoy NeoDyne's "People First" company culture, built on mutual respect, trust, and honesty, where each individual actively contributes as a valued team member.
What might I be doing?
Mechanical Design: Support the design of mechanical systems for industrial, manufacturing and critical infrastructure projects, including equipment layouts, piping and utility systems.
Equipment & Engineering: Assist with equipment selection and specification, and carry out mechanical calculations such as pipe sizing, pressure drops and pump sizing.
Drawings & Documentation: Develop and review mechanical drawings, P&IDs, equipment specifications, datasheets and technical documentation.
Multidisciplinary Projects: Work alongside mechanical, electrical, automation and instrumentation engineers to deliver coordinated engineering solutions.
Site & Commissioning: Visit customer sites to support surveys, installation, equipment inspections, testing and commissioning, gaining hands-on experience of bringing designs into operation.
What about training?
Our induction programme revolves around a 70-20-10 model for learning and development.
70% On-the-job Learning: You'll get stuck in from Day 1, working on real projects, delivering real business value to our customers both on- and off-site.
20% Learning from others: You'll be part of a team, working with subject matter experts and interacting with our customers daily. You'll receive support and guidance, and an invaluable opportunity to learn from former graduates who've seen it and done it.
10% Formal Education: We'll help you become an expert in your chosen field, backed up by formal e-learning and classroom training. This extends to attaining professional certifications where relevant to our business specialisations.
Required
Experience & skills
Level 8 Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical & Manufacturing Engineering, Energy Engineering, or equivalent.
0-2 years' experience in a similar mechanical design role or Work Placement.
Full Irish driving license or to be achieved within 12 months of starting the role.
Desired
A strong understanding of fundamental mechanical engineering principles.
Experience using mechanical design or CAD software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Inventor, Revit or similar.
Characteristics
We look for candidates who
Work well as part of a team.
Have excellent problem solving and diagnostic skills.
Can complete tasks independently, capable of self-learning.
Can prioritise and coordinate work.
Have excellent customer service, interpersonal, communication and organisational skills.
Can multitask and work well under pressure.
Are a strategic business thinker.
What's on offer?
Competitive starting salary with year-on-year bonuses and salary increases
Paid Overtime
Paid Graduation Day
Health Insurance
Income Protection
Life Assurance
PRSA pension with employer contribution
Flexible Working
Personalised Career Development Plan
Professional Certifications, pathways to become a Chartered Engineer
Cycle to work scheme
Apply today!
With our diverse range of business specialisations, customers, and industries that we serve, we offer an unrivalled programme designed to accelerate your personal and professional development. Don't miss this opportunity to join a company at the forefront of industrial automation projects in Ireland, the UK, mainland Europe and the US.
So why wait? Apply Today!
NeoDyne Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be treated in strictest confidence.

jobs.title: Intern
jobs.desc:
Own Every Moment at NetApp
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
About NetApp
The market has shifted. AI is accelerating. The key to AI success is intelligent data and the infrastructure to manage it. Customers are urgently rethinking how they modernize, secure, and unlock value from their data. NetApp is built for this exact moment — with a differentiated platform, deep enterprise credibility, and a clear strategy to win.
Joining NetApp now means operating in a high achievement environment where you are empowered to own every moment. Our culture is grounded in three principles: innovate to elevate, drive results, excel as a team. These are more than words. They define how we show up, how we sell, and how we grow.
Position Overview
As a  Sales Intern you'll gain hands-on experience supporting customer success and learning the fundamentals of modern sales. This internship is ideal for students passionate about building relationships, solving problems, and exploring how technology drives business transformation.  You’ll work with one of our dynamic specialist and hybrid  teams—such as Partner, Strategic, or Commercial Sales, Renewals, Go-to-Market Strategy, Sales Operations, or other areas—contributing to initiatives that strengthen our sales approach and help grow customer relationships. This role offers exposure to innovative sales practices, customer engagement strategies, and data-driven decision-making, all while being mentored by experienced professionals.
Key Responsibilities
Utilize strong interpersonal communication and customer service skills to work effectively with prospects, customers, and cross-functional teams to meet performance goals.
Quickly learn and adopt new sales technologies, CRM systems, and digital tools to support customer engagement activities.
Support the execution of core sales and business development activities while following established sales methodologies and processes.
Drive AI-driven solutions to enhance customer experience and optimize workflows.
Your Profile
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Sales, Communications, or a related field.
Familiarity with AI tools and technologies
Self-starter with a collaborative mindset and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
Creative approach to problem-solving.
You must have the unrestricted right to work in Ireland throughout the duration of the internship.
Available to come into the office three times per week as a part of NetApp’s hybrid work culture.
Start Date
: 4th January, 2027

Equal Opportunity Employer:
NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
Why You'll Thrive at NetApp
At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
Our culture
We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
Submitting an Application

Maintain CRM, sales databases and enquiry tracker; log enquiries, outcomes and follow-ups, prepare quotations, proposals, contracts and sales documentation, and follow up outstanding opportunities.
Produce accurate weekly/monthly sales, enquiry, conversion and pipeline reports; maintain confidentiality and comply with GDPR.
KPIs: enquiry response and follow-up times; CRM accuracy; quotation/document turnaround; report completion; enquiry-to-booking conversion and recorded lost-business reasons.
Meetings & Events Coordination
Support the Meetings & Events team with enquiry qualification, tailored proposals, quotations, contracts, confirmations, function details, rooming lists and event documentation.
Communicate requirements to operational departments, liaise with clients before events, support post-event follow-up and identify suitable upselling opportunities.
KPIs: timely proposals and follow-ups; enquiry conversion and confirmed event revenue; accuracy of event details; additional revenue from upgrades and add-ons; client feedback.
Digital Campaigns & Cross-Department Support
Support email and digital campaigns, seasonal promotions, local opportunities and sales collateral; ensure campaigns direct customers to the correct booking or enquiry channel.
Work collaboratively with Revenue, Reservations, Front Office, Food & Beverage, Leisure, Weddings and Group Commercial teams; escalate pricing, contractual or expenditure decisions requiring approval.

Experience in hotel sales, sales administration, reservations, e-commerce, digital marketing or Meetings & Events; hospitality experience is desirable.
Excellent written and verbal communication, customer service and relationship-management skills, with strong organisation and attention to detail.
Confident using Microsoft Office, databases/CRM and digital platforms; website content, booking engines, social media scheduling, analytics and email marketing experience is desirable.
Commercially aware, proactive and adaptable, able to manage competing deadlines, interpret reports and work independently while contributing to a team.
Relevant qualification in Business, Hospitality, Sales, Marketing or Digital Marketing is desirable. Commitment to confidentiality, GDPR and hotel procedures is essential.
Role Summary
This is a commercially focused role combining e-commerce and social media management, sales administration, digital revenue support and Meetings & Events coordination. By keeping online offers accurate, managing enquiries and follow-ups, supporting event sales and tracking results, the Executive will help improve sales efficiency, customer experience and measurable revenue opportunities. The role operates within approved pricing, brand guidelines and procedures; new rates, discounts, significant campaign spend and non-standard commercial terms require management approval.

Role-specific training in hotel systems, CRM and enquiry tracking, website and booking processes, Meetings & Events procedures, commercial reporting, pricing approvals, GDPR and Talbot Collection standards.

A professional, supportive and collaborative working environment, with the opportunity to build hospitality and commercial experience.

jobs.title: Rail Programme Director
jobs.desc:
Company Description
Work with Us. Change the World.
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
Job Description
AECOM is seeking a strategic and commercially driven Programme Director to lead the growth and delivery of major Rail & Transit programmes across Ireland. Reporting directly to the Transportation Ireland Sector Director and working closely with the Ireland Sector Leadership team and the Transportation Systems (Rail and Transit) Practice as well as AECOM’s global Transportation leadership, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping and delivering the sector’s 3-year growth strategy.
This role is focused on winning and delivering major projects, building high-value client relationships, and driving excellence in project performance, safety, and operational outcomes.
Here’s what you’ll do:
Strategic Growth & Work Winning
Support and drive the sector’s 3-year growth plan across UK & Ireland, in support of the Sector Director’s strategy
Lead positioning, client engagement, and bid activity to win opportunities ≥$5M, including early and enabling packages
Manage the end-to-end work winning process for major programmes
Define and implement the hybrid Enterprise Capability (EC) and. home country delivery model for bids
Enhance AECOM’s market presence and reputation with infrastructure owners, operators, and contractors
Collaborate with global teams to support growth across Europe and India through capability, knowledge, and resource sharing
Project & Client Leadership
Act as AECOM’s senior representative in the delivery of major programmes ≥$5M
Own and lead strategic client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business
Drive continuous improvement based on client feedback and performance outcomes
Lead collaboration with contractors, partners, and supply chain to ensure high-performing delivery teams
Delivery & Commercial Performance
Accountable for successful delivery of Sector owned projects, typically >$5M in revenue, ensuring performance across:
Schedule, cost, and quality
Project governance compliance
Drive strong commercial performance, including:
Sales bookings and revenue growth
Gross/net revenue and margin
Cashflow and DSO performance
Optimisation of EC utilisation
High-quality project data and reporting
Deliver programmes profitably and sustainably, aligned with business objectives
Leadership & Capability Development
Work within Transportation to build capability and capacity aligned to long-term growth
Lead collaboration across Business Lines, sectors, and geographies to unlock opportunities and strengthen delivery
Contribute to the development of a high-performing, globally connected team
Support the implementation of strategic workforce planning and resourcing models
Safety, Health, Environment & Wellbeing (SHE)
Champion and actively lead the SHE & Wellbeing agenda across all major projects
Ensure strong performance against both leading and lagging safety and sustainability metrics
Act as a visible safety leader, embedding best practice across delivery teams and partner organisations
Qualifications
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s what we’re looking for:
Proven market leader with a strong track record of positioning, leading, and winning major opportunities
Extensive experience delivering large-scale, multi-disciplinary infrastructure projects profitably
Demonstrated success working with infrastructure owners, operators, contractors, and partners
Strong commercial acumen with experience managing financial performance and project metrics
Experience operating within a global organisation, collaborating across sectors and geographies
Strong leadership capability, with a focus on developing teams and building long-term capability
Passionate about safety leadership, wellbeing, sustainable delivery, quality and innovation
Additional Information
Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.
To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.
We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Summary
From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl.
Customer obsessed, high energy and love learning every day?
If that sounds like you, earn €460+ per week as a Customer Assistant on our standard 30 hour contract.
You’ll work across different shift times, on varied tasks and with different colleagues.
What does a normal day* as a Customer Assistant look like? (*there’s no such thing as ‘normal’ in retail but we’ve tried our best!)
As a Customer Assistant you are required to sell alcohol, therefore you must be 18 or over to work in our store.
Shift Patterns:
Morning shift: Starting at 5am or 6am with your team, you’ll be getting our award-winning products fully stocked on the shop floor and our delicious bakery products ready for our customers to enjoy by opening time so they can Go Full Lidl!
Middle shift: Starting mid-morning or early afternoon, you’ll make sure our stores are spotlessly clean, well presented and our products remain fresh, all while helping customers with queries on the shop floor and working on tills to minimise till queues
Late shift: From your start time in the afternoon, you’ll make sure our customers experience is top class by serving them with a smile while on the tills, restocking missing items and getting the store ready for the next day

Interacting with the customer in a pleasant, friendly and helpful manner

To enjoy working in a fast-paced, varied environment

Paralegal/Company Secretary

You will work closely with the Legal Team and senior stakeholders across the business to support board and committee governance, assist with corporate transactions, and provide day‑to‑day legal and administrative support.

Company secretarial & governance

Regulatory & compliance support

Support the roll‑out of compliance policies, procedures and training (e.g. data protection, anti‑bribery, competition law) from an administrative and coordination perspective.

#ijadvantage

Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and follow‑through.
Commercially aware and pragmatic, with a solutions‑focused mindset.

Supportive, collaborative culture with opportunities for professional development and further training.

jobs.title: Specialist, Supply Chain Operations, Global External Operations
jobs.desc:
Who We Are
BioMarin is a leading rare disease biotechnology company focused on genetically defined conditions.
Guided by our purpose to develop medicines that make a profound impact on people’s lives, our global teams have delivered a portfolio of therapies since our founding in 1997. Our revolutionary treatments for conditions like achondroplasia (the most common form of dwarfism), PKU (phenylketonuria), CLN2, a form of Batten disease, and a number of forms of MPS (mucopolysaccharidosis) offer new possibilities for patients and families who previously had few, if any, available options. More recently, with the close of the Amicus acquisition, our portfolio has expanded to include therapies for Fabry disease and Pompe disease, expanding our ability to reach more people living with rare genetic conditions.
Our success comes from our unwavering commitment to excellence, our deep understanding of patient needs, our scientific expertise, and our world-class manufacturing capabilities. At the heart of BioMarin is a dedicated team of the brightest minds in the industry working together to deliver innovative therapies to patients and families around the world.
About Technical Operations
BioMarin’s Technical Operations group is responsible for creating our drugs for use in clinical trials and for scaling production of those drugs for the commercial market. These engineers, technicians, scientists and support staff build and maintain BioMarin’s cutting-edge manufacturing processes and sites, provide quality assurance and quality control to ensure we meet regulatory standards, and procure the needed goods and services to support manufacturing and coordinating the worldwide movement of our drugs to patients.
Specialist, Supply Chain Operations, Global External Operations
Shanbally, Ringaskiddy
Hybrid role 2-3 days per week onsite
Closing date: 9 October 2026
Summary
The GEO Supply Chain Operations Specialist serves as an integral member of the Global External Operations team who has responsibility for and plays a key role in readiness for external contract manufacturing activities relating to commercial drug products. They help coordinate starting material, drug product and finished packaged goods supply needs between contract manufacturers and internal BioMarin teams to ensure that all commercial and clinical needs are defined and met. The candidate is required to work closely with a cross-functional team and coordinate activities between Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, MSAT and the contract manufacturer. The GEO Supply Chain Operations Specialist reports to the Director, Supply Chain Operations, GEO
Responsibilities
Analyse, issue and execute with the CMO the production plan to deliver an uninterrupted supply of clinical & commercial product
Identify any supply constraints and negotiate/resolve with the CMO any issues to meet the supply plan
Maintain a visual metric/dashboard to provide oversight of the production plan
Act as the focus and conduit for communications between the CMO and with members of BioMarin Process Teams and other departments to meet the supply plan
Attend periodically at the CMO to monitor production and develop an in-depth knowledge of the manufacturing process and systems at the CMO
Manage ERP aspects at BioMarin for purchasing and production efforts at CMO
Monitor and manage inventory levels of drug substance, drug product, finish goods and components as applicable at the CMO site
Coordinate BioMarin activities in the evaluation/execution of issues, process changes, change requests and deviations to ensure timely resolution without impacting on supply
PO and Invoice Management – generation and coordination of POs and resolution of payment holds
Commit Process – maintain work order dates to match CMO order confirmations and changes in schedule to support supply plan visibility and master scheduling
Shipment Management – form completion, shipment coordination, inbound & outbound, DS/DP/bulk packs & samples
Inventory Reconciliation – manage monthly reconciliation process for relevant CMOs, prepare for and be primary SME for inventory audits of responsible CMOs
Coordination of reference standard supply with relevant CMOs
Coordination of annual stability samples with relevant CMOs
Other duties as assigned.

Experience with CAPA, FMEA, RCA tools in a highly regulated manufacturing environment is desired.
Strong written and verbal communication, commercial acumen.
A high level of initiative and questioning skills are key role requirements, as well as strong organizational skills.

Experience in inventory reconciliation.
Working knowledge of GXP regulations.

General Summary
Qualcomm Cloud Edge in Cork is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead development of Linux-based system software for next‑generation datacenter and secure compute platforms. This role focuses on host-side software, drivers, and system integration for Qualcomm’s high‑performance inference accelerators and secure compute solutions.
As a Staff Engineer, you will own complex subsystems end‑to‑end, drive architectural decisions, and provide technical leadership across software, hardware, and platform teams. Your work will span driver development, test infrastructure, performance optimization, security enablement, and product commercialization, with a strong emphasis on robust, production‑ready system software.
Key Responsibilities
Host & System Software Development
Design, implement, and optimize Linux user‑space and kernel‑adjacent drivers and libraries in modern C++.
Lead development of host software stacks supporting high‑performance AI inference and secure compute workloads.
Drive API design, multi‑threaded systems, and scalable software architectures.
Own feature development, integration, and bring‑up across hardware and software boundaries.
Testing, Quality & CI
Architect and develop unit, integration, and system‑level tests for CI environments.
Lead functional and performance validation of host software and drivers.
Establish best practices for testability, automation, and long‑term maintainability.
Secure Compute & Virtualization (Differentiating Scope)
Integrate host software with Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) including Secure VMs (CVM) and Software‑Isolated VMs (SIVM).
Enable secure PCIe device assignment, SR‑IOV, and container/VM‑based workloads.
Implement and support device attestation, lifecycle management, and secure interface configuration.
Collaborate on PCIe firewall, memory protection, and register isolation features.
Performance, Debug & Bring‑Up
Debug complex host‑side issues including boot flows, PCIe link behavior, log transfer, and overflow handling.
Optimize host software for AI inference performance and low‑latency workloads.
Use advanced debugging, tracing, and profiling tools on Linux platforms.
Technical Leadership & Collaboration
Provide technical leadership across mixed hardware/software teams.
Drive design reviews, influence system architecture, and mentor senior engineers.
Work closely with hardware, firmware, hypervisor, security, and cloud teams to deliver end‑to‑end solutions.
Support customer deployments and resolve complex system‑level issues.
Required Skills And Experience
Extensive experience with Linux system software development in modern C/C++.
Strong background in Linux user‑space development, API design, and multi‑threading / synchronization.
Solid understanding of Linux internals, kernel concepts, drivers, and system bring‑up.
Experience with UML, OO design, and large‑scale software architecture.
Strong knowledge of SoC architecture (cores, caches, memory hierarchy, interconnects, I/O).
Experience with source code and configuration management (git required).
Proven ability to work at low‑level implementation detail while maintaining system‑level perspective.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Comfortable operating in a high‑caliber, cross‑disciplinary engineering environment.
Staff‑Level Expectations
Typically 6+ years of relevant industry experience in system or platform software.
Demonstrated ownership of complex subsystems across multiple releases.
Ability to set technical direction, not just execute tasks.
Track record of influencing architecture, quality, and engineering standards.
Desirable / Stand‑Out Skills
These are not strictly required, but will significantly differentiate candidates:
Experience with secure compute, confidential computing, or TEEs.
Familiarity with virtualization and container technologies (KVM, Docker, SR‑IOV).
Knowledge of cryptographic protocols, device security, and attestation mechanisms.
Experience optimizing AI/ML inference workloads on system software stacks.
Proficiency in Python for tooling, testing, or automation.
Experience with C/C++ unit testing frameworks (e.g., gtest).
Exposure to cloud technologies, middleware, and protocols.
Working knowledge of PCIe 3.0+.
Linux system administration experience.
Contributions to open‑source kernel or confidential computing projects.
Where you will be working
Cork has a proud reputation as Ireland's second largest economic engine and is now one of the Top 20 location choices in Europe with 39,000 people being employed by over 170 overseas companies.
There's a growing diversity in the region with people from many nationalities relocating to Cork, relishing the opportunity to work and live in a location that offers an excellent quality of life.
A gateway to Europe, Cork airport provides access to almost 50 international destinations including transatlantic air routes.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any protected classification.

OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR

A proven track record in project and programme risk & opportunity management within infrastructure, construction, engineering, or the built environment
A recognised risk qualification such as IRM Diploma, PMI-RMP, MoR Practitioner, APM Risk Practitioner, or equivalent

You'll stand out even more if you have
A project management qualification such as PMP, PMQ/APM, or PRINCE2
Working knowledge of industry standards and frameworks, including ISO 31000, COSO ERM, and APM PRAM
Professional membership with organisations such as IRM, APM, PMI, or equivalent

A quick note
This role is specifically focused on project risk management within infrastructure, engineering, and the built environment. While we value a broad range of risk experience, candidates whose background is primarily in financial, commercial, IT, digital, cyber, or legal risk are unlikely to have the specialised project delivery experience required for this position.

jobs.desc:
Description
This role can be performed from the following countries: Luxembourg, UK/IE, France, Germany, Italy, Spain. There will be travel required up to 30% of the time, mostly within the EU.
About The Role
Join Amazon's Employee Experience & Relations (EXR) team in Europe and play a decisive role in shaping how 12 countries navigate one of the most complex labor relations environments in the world.
As the EU EXR Business Partner (BP) for OPS Central Functions & RME Tech field, you will develop and own end-to-end employee and labor relations strategies for the business populations you cover across the EU. You will serve as a direct strategic advisor to the most senior EU Operations leaders - including the VPs who run mission-critical functions - counselling them on employee experience, regulatory compliance and labor relations risk so they can make informed, confident decisions with significant business impact.
Reporting into the EU Business Partners and Project, Compliance & Risk ER Director, you will cover OPS Central Functions & RME Tech field across Europe — primarily IT Ops & RME, 3P Transportation & Scaling, and Supply Chain Transformation Planning & Ops Excellence. Each function reports to distinct VPs and presents unique employee experience dynamics - from highly specialized technical teams with outsized operational leverage to scaling organizations navigating rapid transformation, along with field team living day-to-day at the pace of the miles - requiring a Business Partner who can diagnose distinct needs, develop proportionate strategies, and deliver pragmatic counsel while maintaining strategic coherence and Amazon's EXR standards.
As the EXR Business Partner for those VPs, you will act as a trusted advisor who translates business priorities and challenges to EXR plans and outcomes. You will look closely after the employee experience in scope, and partner with PXT to build convincing improvement strategies. You will support organizational changes and respond to emerging business and risk opportunities at EU level. You will work in close collaboration with other EXR Business Partners, Country Field ER teams, and respective Head of Country ER Leadership to deliver specific country insights and ensure that fair, consistent, and transparent employee experience processes are applied across all operations.
Key job responsibilities
Role
As an EXR Business Partner, you will be the trusted strategic advisor who translates complex business priorities into actionable employee and labor relations strategies. This role is a strategic advisory and relationship-driven role where your primary impact comes from:
The quality of counsel you provide to senior leaders navigating ambiguous, high-stakes situations
Your ability to connect regulatory, operational, and human dynamics into coherent strategies
The trust you build as the go-to partner whom VPs seek out before making workforce decisions
Your judgment in balancing business agility with employee experience and compliance imperatives
Specifically, You Will
Develop end-to-end ELR strategies for the business populations you serve, ensuring each strategy is grounded in local regulatory context, business operating models, and workforce dynamics across the EU;
Advise VPs and senior leaders directly on labor relations risk exposure, regulatory compliance obligations, and employee experience opportunities - providing clear, data-backed recommendations that enable timely decision-making;
Identify, assess, and mitigate pan-EU employee relations risk by leveraging risk frameworks, employee listening mechanisms, site assessments, and workforce analytics to surface trends before they escalate;
Shape the employee experience across your customer groups by designing targeted interventions, visiting site to get employee’s experience feedback firsthand, testing solutions through local ER partnerships, and scaling what works across the network;
Navigate regulatory complexity by maintaining deep awareness of evolving EU labor legislation and advising business leaders on compliance implications about strategic projects, mitigation options, and strategic positioning;
Lead through influence during critical moments - including organizational change, workforce restructuring, and crisis situations - partnering with ER Country Leaders to ensure coordinated, legally sound, and employee-centric responses;
Drive strategic coherence across diverse populations by developing tailored approaches for each business function while maintaining a unified pan-EU framework that delivers consistency, fairness, and transparency;
Partner cross-functionally with PxT, Legal, L&D, GOLD, and Operations Corporate teams to build leader capability and deliver cohesive employee experience across all touchpoints.

Operational Excellence
Use operational data, EXR metrics, and business KPIs to develop persuasive narratives and evidence-based recommendations
Lead and deliver complex, cross-functional strategy at pan-EU scale from scoping through execution and measurement of impact
Deliver innovative solutions that challenge the status quo and drive measurable improvements in employee experience
Define and track success metrics for EXR initiatives, ensuring accountability and continuous improvement
Leadership Capabilities
Navigate high ambiguity and competing priorities across multiple stakeholder groups with minimal direction, exercising sound judgment to drive outcomes
Influence senior leaders through data-driven insights, pragmatic solutions, and deep understanding of their respective business challenges
Build and sustain constructive, trusted advisory relationships with senior leaders and multiple stakeholders across functions and geographies
Produce high-quality written communications that analyse problems, present data-backed options, and recommend clear paths forward
Self Development
Seek learning opportunities and champion new ideas within the EXR function
Reflect on strengths and growth areas, actively seeking feedback from peers and stakeholders
Lead authentically through self-awareness and transparency
Build a diverse network of leaders across the organization
Develop strong working relationships with VPs, along with internal and external partners
About The Team
The EU Employee Experience & Relations team is a high-performing, pan-European function supporting all Amazon Operations business lines to drive employee experience and manage labor relations strategies across the EU Region. Acting as a Center of Expertise, we are committed to building capability, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering positive employee relations & constructive labor relations at scale. Our team operates at the intersection of strategy and execution - partnering closely with Operations, Legal, Public Relations, and Global EXR to advise on critical initiatives and deliver solutions that matter for our employees and customers.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree
Experience in Employee Experience / Labor Relations roles, with demonstrated multi-country EU exposure
Fluency in written and spoken English (Common European Framework of Reference C2)
Proven track record of building trusted advisory relationships with executive stakeholders (Director level and above)
Experience leading organizational change initiatives across multiple countries in a complex, matrixed organization
Demonstrated ability to use data and business metrics to inform EXR strategy and recommendations
Preferred Qualifications
Relevant postgraduate education in human resources or employee/labor relations
Fluency in an additional European language (Common European Framework of Reference C2)
Experience supporting corporate/central functions or specialized technical populations (as distinct from high-volume frontline operations)
Proven ability to design, pilot, and scale employee experience programs from concept to measurable impact

Join a Practice Where Relationships Matter
At Sunbeam Vets Kinsale Road, we believe great veterinary care starts with great relationships. We're looking for a Small Animal Veterinary Surgeon to join our friendly and dedicated team in a well-established first opinion practice that has become a trusted part of the local community.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a confident GP vet who enjoys building lasting client relationships, delivering excellent clinical care, and working as part of a close-knit, supportive team. You'll be joining a small, experienced team where every individual makes a real difference, with the backing and resources of the wider Sunbeam Veterinary Group when needed.
The Opportunity
This role offers an excellent balance of medicine, surgery, preventative healthcare, and client engagement. As a key member of the clinical team, you'll manage a varied caseload of first opinion small animal cases, providing high-quality care from initial consultation through to diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing case management.
You'll be comfortable independently working up medical cases, developing treatment plans, interpreting diagnostic results, and performing routine soft tissue surgeries. While more advanced and specialist procedures can be referred to our larger teams and referral services within the Sunbeam network, we are looking for a vet who is confident managing day-to-day GP veterinary work without close supervision.
The role also includes elements of sole charge, making it ideally suited to an experienced veterinary surgeon who enjoys autonomy while still benefiting from the support of a collaborative team environment.
An interest in exotic species would be welcomed but is not essential.
Who We're Looking For
We're seeking a well-rounded Small Animal GP Veterinary Surgeon who is passionate about delivering excellent patient care and building strong relationships with clients and colleagues alike.
To be successful in this role, you must be VCI registered and confident managing routine first opinion medical and surgical cases independently. This includes procedures such as dog and cat spays, lump removals, routine diagnostics, case workups, and ongoing medical management.
Due to the level of autonomy required, this position is not suitable for new graduates or veterinary surgeons who require close supervision, structured mentorship, or extensive clinical support. We are looking for someone who can confidently contribute from day one and thrive within a busy first opinion environment.
A Supportive Team with a Community Focus
Sunbeam Vets Kinsale Road is home to a small and experienced team consisting of two veterinary surgeons, two veterinary nurses, and a dedicated receptionist. Together, we've built a welcoming practice where teamwork, trust, and client care are at the heart of everything we do.
Many of our clients have been with us for years, creating a genuine community atmosphere and allowing our team to develop meaningful, long-term relationships with both pets and their owners.
As part of the wider Sunbeam Veterinary Group, you'll also have access to the expertise, facilities, and support of a larger network including clinics in Blackpool, Cobh, and Passage West, as well as our specialist referral and emergency services.
Modern Facilities with the Support of a Larger Network
Our Kinsale Road branch is well-equipped with digital radiography, dental radiography, ultrasound, and in-house diagnostic capabilities, enabling efficient and thorough patient care.

24/7 emergency and critical care with round-the-clock veterinary cover
A team of approximately 9 veterinary surgeons and 15 qualified veterinary nurses

Soft tissue and orthopaedic surgery
Advanced diagnostic imaging

Located on the south side of Cork City, Kinsale Road offers the perfect balance of city convenience and community charm. With excellent transport links, easy access to Cork city centre, Cork Airport, and some of Ireland's most beautiful coastal towns, it's a fantastic place to live and work.
The area combines the energy of a thriving city with the warmth of a local neighbourhood, creating an ideal environment for veterinary professionals who enjoy becoming a valued part of their local community.

This is a permanent part-time position working 32 hours per week on a planned rota basis, with schedules provided in advance.

Weekend commitment includes: 1 in 4 Saturdays: 9:00am to 2:00pm, 1 in 8 Sundays: 8:00am to 7:00pm

If you're an experienced Small Animal Veterinary Surgeon looking for a role where you can enjoy genuine clinical autonomy, build lasting client relationships, and become part of a welcoming and supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Full-stack Software Engineer
jobs.desc:
What You Will Do
Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking a
Senior Software Engineer
to join our AI Engineering team. This is a
hands-on, full-stack role
focused on building the front-end and back-end application layers that enable AI teams to deliver enterprise solutions.
You will work alongside AI engineers, data scientists, platform engineers, product teams to move AI use cases from proof of concept into secure, scalable and supportable products. You will build user interfaces in Blazor and React, develop APIs and services in .NET and Python, and integrate applications with generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows and enterprise data services.
This role suits an experienced software engineer who understands that successful AI products require more than a model: they require strong application architecture, thoughtful user experience, robust integration, security, observability, testing and disciplined software delivery.
As this is a
Cork-based hybrid role requiring attendance in the office three days per week
, candidates who are not currently based in Cork or the surrounding area would be expected to relocate.
How You Will Do It
Full-stack application engineering
Design, build and maintain production-grade web applications that expose AI capabilities through clear, responsive and accessible user experiences.
Develop component-based front ends using C#, Razor/Blazor, CSS and JavaScript, applying responsive design, accessibility and reusable design-system patterns.
Build secure back-end services and REST APIs using C# and .NET, with Python services where required for AI and data integration.
Design application boundaries, contracts and integration patterns across front ends, APIs, AI services, data stores and enterprise platforms.
Implement authentication, authorisation, input validation, error handling, auditability and secure management of secrets and configuration.
Improve performance, reliability and maintainability through profiling, caching, asynchronous processing and sound engineering patterns.
AI application development
Integrate applications with Azure OpenAI and other approved model endpoints, Azure AI Foundry capabilities, AI Search, vector stores and enterprise APIs.
Build application experiences for conversational AI, enterprise search, document intelligence, summarisation, recommendations and AI-assisted workflows.
Implement streaming responses, citations and source attribution, structured outputs, tool calling, conversation state and human-in-the-loop controls.
Collaborate with AI engineers on RAG and agentic solutions, translating model or workflow capabilities into well-designed user-facing features.
Implement practical safeguards including prompt and output validation, content filtering, access controls, graceful fallback and clear user feedback.
Measure and optimise end-to-end quality, latency, reliability and cost, including the application behaviour around non-deterministic AI responses.
Software delivery and operational excellence
Own features through design, implementation, code review, automated testing, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
Create unit, component, integration, contract and end-to-end tests using TypeScript, PowerShell and C# where appropriate, including test strategies for AI-enabled and streaming user journeys.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, applying quality gates, environment configuration and repeatable release practices.
Containerise applications and deploy to Azure services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps or AKS, as appropriate.
Instrument applications with logs, metrics, traces and usage telemetry; diagnose production issues and participate in incident response and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to secure coding, accessibility, privacy, Responsible AI, architecture and engineering standards across the AI application portfolio.
Technical leadership and collaboration
Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to turn ambiguous business needs into measurable, testable software requirements and incremental delivery plans.
Provide technical direction through solution design, architecture discussions, code reviews and pragmatic trade-off decisions.
Mentor engineers in full-stack design, software quality, AI integration and production engineering practices.
Create reusable components, reference implementations and development patterns that help multiple AI teams deliver consistently.
Communicate technical risks, dependencies and options clearly to engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
Required Experience
What we look for
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with evidence of senior-level ownership of production applications.
Strong hands-on experience building modern web applications with C#, Razor/Blazor, CSS and JavaScript on the front end, and C#/.NET back-end services.
Production experience with Razor/Blazor user interfaces, including component design, state management, CSS styling, JavaScript interoperability and front-end testing.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating front ends with distributed back-end services.
Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled applications, such as generative AI, LLM, RAG, conversational AI, document intelligence or agent-based solutions.
Experience with Azure-hosted applications and automated delivery using Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to take software from design through deployment and operational support in an enterprise environment.
Experience creating automation and test tooling with TypeScript, PowerShell and C#.
Desired Qualifications
Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph or comparable orchestration frameworks.
Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, Cosmos DB, Redis, PostgreSQL/pgvector or other vector-capable data services.
Experience with real-time communication and streaming technologies such as SignalR, Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.
Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control and enterprise API security.
Experience implementing WCAG-aligned accessible interfaces and working with enterprise design systems.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AKS or API Management.
Knowledge of LLM evaluation, prompt/version management, tracing, cost controls, Responsible AI, privacy and AI governance.
Experience in IoT, smart buildings, industrial applications or other operational technology domains.

Folláin is Ireland's No.1 preserves brand, made in West Cork since 1983. As the fastest-growing brand in our category, with a diverse portfolio of products and customers, we're looking for a Sales & Marketing Intern to support our brand-building activity and the continued growth and development of our product portfolio across customers.
This is a genuine 50/50 role: you'll split your time between marketing the brand and working with our sales team and key customers.

• Support the planning, creation and management of our social media and paid Meta campaigns, monitoring performance, analysing results and spotting ways to improve.
• Help coordinate PR drops, influencer activity and brand collaborations that grow Folláin's reach and connect us with new audiences.

• Support the growth of our products within key domestic and export customer accounts.
• Liaise regularly with key accounts to keep them satisfied with our products and service, resolving any concerns and keeping communication flowing between Folláin teams and customer contacts.
• Help activate our trade plans with key customers, and work with the field sales team so store activations, promotions and sales objectives are delivered at store level.

•Exposure to retail, foodservice and export customers, including head office meetings and trade shows.

•Is currently studying towards, or has recently completed, a third-level degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, Food Business or a related discipline.
• Is passionate about food, FMCG and the success of the Irish food industry, and excited to represent a proudly Irish brand known for great-tasting, wholesome, high-quality products.
• Is creative and digitally savvy, with a strong interest in content creation, social media and digital marketing.
• Knows Instagram, TikTok and Meta advertising well; familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Canva and WooCommerce is an advantage.
• Communicates clearly and confidently, in writing and in person, including with customers.

Contract Type:
12 months | Temp Contract

Job Description
The Training Coordinator is responsible for the coordination and implementation of learning solutions across Kinsale, including administration of Kinsale curricula. The Training Coordinator partners with the business to ensure curricula adequately reflect job responsibilities and compliance-based activities. The Training Coordinator is responsible for training projects identified as fulfilling the learning capability and competency gaps in the assigned business area/function. Additionally, the Training Coordinator is responsible for activities required to maintain the overall state of compliance of the Training Compliance program.
The Training Coordinator monitors process, progress, results, and designs feedback loops into their work against measured goals. The Training Coordinator should anticipate and adjust for problems and roadblocks, interface with learning service suppliers, and integrate new business processes where necessary for success. The Training Coordinator provides support to ensure personnel are qualified and capable, which includes personnel fulfilling compliance requirements and continually increasing their contribution to the business.
Key Responsibilities
Training Coordinator Portfolio Management
Identify, analyze, and determine solutions regarding learning gaps.
Define requirements for personnel qualification in assigned business area/function; ensure implementation and ongoing maintenance.
Create, revise, and implement training and related documents, ensuring all documents are well written and executable.
Evaluate effectiveness of existing and planned learning interventions.
Evaluate human errors in business units and determine appropriate human error reduction interventions.
Collaborate/participate in Network/Functional initiatives.
Partner with the business in the creation and management of training materials.
Create initial project charters with defined scope documents and statements of work.
Participate on project teams; lead assigned projects.

Anticipate and resolve project/program issues, escalating as appropriate.

Drive quality standards through review of project documents, design, deliverables, final learning content and evaluation data.
Stay abreast of the breadth of learning solutions to guide business partners to the most effective learning methods, solutions and outcomes.
Benchmark within Learning and Development organizations in other sites, seeking sharing and replication opportunities.
Conduct usability testing as required.
Share business metrics and interpretations with management.
Client Management
Actively participate in area/function project and process teams.
Analyze/understand the assigned business area/function, including business goals, job titles and descriptions, key duties, and responsibilities.
Monitor client satisfaction of learning program implementation. Share results with management and make recommendations.
Surface improvement opportunities within Training Compliance.
Consult across the assigned business area/function to ensure training plans align with business plan, strategic direction, and compliance and ethics.
Effectively communicate updates for projects and assignments.
Curriculum Architecture and Assignment
Identify target audience for specific learning intervention.
Create and maintain duty-aligned curricula with business partners and support curricula owners in the business.
Ensure accuracy and appropriateness of target audience definitions for courses owned by assigned business area/function in the Learning Management System (LMS).
Troubleshoot curriculum architecture and assignment and resolve issues.
Implement centrally-developed process improvements in local area.

Experience in technical writing

Experience with learning & development and SOP business processes

Ability to work independently and in a team environment
Responsible for maintaining a safe work environment, working safely and accountable for supporting all Corporate and Site Goals
Additional Preferences:
Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment
Experience in business area/function as well as knowledge of companion tools used to execute broader business processes (such as CAPA tools/TrackWise, document repositories/Veeva QualityDocs)
Experience in supplier oversight
Ability to effectively partner outside functional area
Ability to navigate complex organizations
Strong organizational skills
Demonstrated ability to coach others
Education Requirements:
Bachelor’s Degree or 2+ years of experience in a Learning & Development role
Other Information:
Travel may be required.
Applicant will work in various areas within a manufacturing site. Allergens are likely in the manufacturing environment. Mobility requirements and exposure to allergens should be considered when applying for this position.

Bike to work

Subsidised meals onsite

Kiernan Engineering are looking to hire an experienced electrical estimator to determine the approximate costs of various electrical installations for industrial and residential projects. Providing viable solutions to increase project profitability.
Completing and submitting competitive project bids in accordance with established guidelines.
Regularly updating cost databases to accurately reflect fluctuating material and labour costs.
Evaluating labour and material costs to determine whether it is more feasible to construct electrical components or sub-contract the construction of components.

Completion of a postsecondary education electrician training program.

The ability to interpret blueprints.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent organisational skills.
Effective communication skills.
Exceptional customer service skills

Join us in a pivotal accounting role where you'll shape financial reporting for a global technology leader. You'll work on statutory compliance and financial statements for Amazon Web Services and our satellite connectivity initiative, serving communities worldwide with innovative broadband solutions. This position offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact on how we report financial performance across multiple regions while collaborating with teams around the globe.

Prepare month-end statutory close journal entries and supporting documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable accounting standards

In this role, you'll focus on statutory reporting and compliance work that directly supports our financial integrity across the organization. Job Title:

Reports To:
Finance Director
Contract:
Fulltime/Permanent
The Opportunity
Arlo's finance team is expanding and we're seeking a Cost Accounting Manager to join our team in Cork. This is a permanent, high-visibility role for an experienced cost accountant ready to take full ownership of a complex, SOX-relevant function within a US-listed public company.
Job Summary
Reporting to the Finance Director, you will own Arlo's cost accounting function end-to-end covering standard costing, inventory reserves, period cost reporting, and management presentations. You will partner closely with the US Corporate Controller, FP&A, Operations, and External Audit, and may have direct report(s). A key focus of the role will be identifying opportunities to streamline and automate manual processes, driving greater efficiency across the function. Flexibility to work overlapping hours with US time zones during close periods is essential.
Key Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end standard costing process, including quarterly cost uploads, new SKU administration, and overhead rate reviews.
Lead the quarterly calculation and reporting of inventory reserves, including Excess & Obsolete, Lower of Cost or Market, Used Inventory, and ODM Excess Materials Liability.
Prepare and present period cost actuals and forecasts to senior management, including the quarterly Inventory Management and Period Cost Review.
Partner closely with Operations department to oversee various cost components. Provide accounting analysis and insights to such cost components, such as PPV or Tariff/Duty charges.
Oversee the monthly and quarterly Cost Trial Balance and Standard Margin reconciliations, and post-close cost allocations.
Act as a key point of contact for external auditors (Deloitte) on cost accounting and inventory-related controls.
As needed, provide oversight and day-to-day management to the Cost Accountant, ensuring quality and timeliness across the team's deliverables.
Drive continuous improvement across cost accounting processes, systems, and controls, with a focus on identifying opportunities to streamline and automate manual workflows.
What We’re Looking For
Recognized accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent).
Significant experience in cost accounting within a manufacturing, hardware, or technology company.
Strong knowledge of standard costing, inventory valuation, and reserve calculations under US GAAP.
Experience operating in a public company or SOX-compliant environment.
Proficiency in Oracle EBS/OCI and advanced Excel skills; experience with OAS is an advantage.
Proven ability to take full ownership of complex processes while managing across a global team.
Strong communicator with the confidence to present to senior stakeholders and partner with US based teams.
A track record of identifying opportunities to streamline and automate manual accounting processes, with the initiative to drive change and improve efficiency.

ADI are looking for recognized industry leaders at the forefront of mixed-signal design. Play a key role in delivering ADI’s strategy to solve the world’s most complex challenges through deep collaboration with global leaders across core vertical markets.
As a Senior Principal Analog / Mixed-Signal Design Engineer, you will serve as a technical authority in the design and development of sophisticated mixed-signal integrated circuits. You will be responsible for driving advancements in mixed-signal design while mentoring other engineers and representing ADI's technical excellence internally and externally.

Perform advanced block and transistor-level design, simulation, evaluation, and debugging to ensure optimal performance across process, voltage, and temperature variations
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product definers, verification, process, test, and application engineers to define specifications and features
Drive architecture development and innovation for new circuit designs and methodologies, contributing to IP development and patent generation
Drive innovation in mixed-signal design approaches, developing new theories and methods that advance the company's technological capabilities
Lead complex mixed-signal projects with significant business impact, directing work of engineering teams without formal management responsibility
Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior design engineers, developing engineering talent and driving robust design practices
Drive regional university engagements to build and maintain strong talent pipelines
Drive external technical leadership and innovation through high-impact publications, active engagement with the broader engineering community, and the development of novel IP and patentable solutions that enhance ADI’s competitive differentiation
Partner with business leaders to influence product roadmaps and technology direction
Must Have Skills
Advanced Analog Circuit Design Expertise: Extensive knowledge of analog circuits including amplifiers, filters, and data converters with proven ability to solve complex design challenges independently
Mixed-Signal IC Design Mastery: Advanced understanding of mixed-signal integration, analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog conversion techniques, and system-level integration challenges
Simulation and Modeling Mastery: Advanced proficiency with simulation modeling tools (SPICE, Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre) and ability to develop custom simulation methodologies
Integrated Circuit Layout: Deep understanding of physical IC layout considerations and experience optimizing layouts for performance, including guiding layout engineers on critical aspects
Communication and Influence: Outstanding ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, drive design reviews, and mentor junior engineers across multiple complex projects
Preferred Education And Experience
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with at least 15 years of relevant industry experience
Strong record of accomplishment and innovation (ex: leadership of commercially successful development efforts, patents, presentations at leading conferences, publications in leading journals)
