At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world.
Your expertise will shape the future of technology, and you’ll be supported by a culture that values continuous advancement and professional growth. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect.

About The Role
We have great opportunity for a Laboratory (Sampling) Technician in our Kinisla site in Charleville, Co. Cork.
This is a part-time role, to cover Plant 1 & Plant 2 labs at weekends, including bank holidays. Working hours are 06:00 - 15:00. Overtime is available.
The successful candidate will help to ensure, that our products continue to meet the highest quality standards and delighting our customers, working within the team and reporting to a Quality Manager.
Kinisla Group's UK & Ireland dairy related business includes Dairy Ingredients, Dairy Nutritional Ingredients, Dairy Consumer Foods, and Agribusiness. With a revenue in excess of €1bn per year, it is one of the world's leading dairy businesses. With our strong dairy heritage and deep-rooted connection to our 3,000 milk suppliers, right through to our portfolio of innovative and high-quality brands, the dairy business has a unique and compelling proposition for both consumers and our customers.
Our dairy business has a diversified portfolio of dairy, nutritional ingredients and market leading dairy brands and its vertically integrated dairy processing ensures the highest quality, sustainably produced 1.2bn litres of milk for our dairy, nutritional ingredients, and consumer foods business - a key consideration among some of our largest customers across the globe.

In process product chemical testing of samples according to documented procedures paying attention to sample preparation & control to prevent cross contamination of samples and temperature controls
Maintaining accurate and clearly documented testing records to ensure traceability

Chemical analysis: pH, fats, salt, moisture
Raw material collection & analysis
Preparation and executing Environmental swabbing within the production area
Carrying out required temperature checks in the production area
Managing shelf life samples
Managing samples to go external lab for micro testing
Carrying out adhoc duties as required
Entering test results into SAP
What do I need to be successful?
In Kinisla we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. Accuracy & high level of attention to detail
Able to manage workload and time efficiently
Ability to work independently & off own initiative without supervision
Effective communication skills
Ability to problem solve independently
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel
Excellent understanding of computers & ability to work independently on computers
Ability to quickly learn & understand how to use computer programmes
Must be available for weekends & occasional Mon-Fri cover

About Kinisla
Kinisla is a vertically integrated farm-to-fork business with a very substantial consumer foods presence and a leading nutritional and dairy ingredients division, delivering high-quality dairy solutions with a focus on sustainability and innovation. From partnering with local family farms to producing world-class dairy products, we ensure every step of our value chain reflects our commitment to excellence.
With over 50 years' experience in milk processing, dairy and nutritional technology advancement, and product innovation, we are a key stakeholder in the global food industry and creators of a strong portfolio of market leading dairy brands including Cheestrings, Charleville and Coleraine Cheese, Dairygold, Golden Cow and our new SMUG range. Our from food, for food culture and deep-rooted connection to our 2,800 milk suppliers differentiates our business and offers captivating opportunities for our customers and consumers.
Our dairy comes from some of the world's richest grazing land and is produced by a network of Irish family farms that have one of the lowest carbon footprints in the world. Through a combination of expertise, innovation, and sustainability, Kinisla is proud to shape the future of dairy while meeting the diverse needs of our farmers, customers, and communities.
Headquartered in Tralee, Co. Kerry, we operate multiple manufacturing facilities in the southwest of Ireland, including Listowel, Charleville, Newmarket, and Farranfore. Additionally, we manage 28 Farm & Home stores throughout the region, ensuring comprehensive coverage and service. In Northern Ireland and the United Kingdom, our presence extends to key locations in Portadown, Coleraine, and Ossett.
Globally, Kinisla employs over 1,700 dedicated professionals across Ireland, Northern Ireland, the UK, USA, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, and China. In 2024, we achieved a turnover of approximately €1.3 billion, reflecting our commitment to excellence and growth.

Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we’re built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business.
Why join the Graduate Management Training Programme?
As a Graduate Management Trainee, you'll have the freedom and support to explore your leadership potential - and the opportunity to become a branch manager in one of our retail operations in as little as two years. In fact, most of our senior leaders began their careers in this very role - including our current CEO.

Whether you’re building on existing strengths or developing new ones, your growth is our priority. Through classroom learning, on-the-job training, and mentorship, you’ll have the tools and support to take the next step – and the one after that.
Our doors are open
As a Graduate Management Trainee, your experience at Enterprise Mobility will be as unique as you because you shape who we are as much as we shape your skills, path and potential. We pride ourselves on opening our doors to a variety of voices, giving way to an experience that’s both inclusive and that inspires diversity of thought.

deliver exceptional experiences by confidently handling reservations, resolving enquiries, and building rapport with a diverse range of customers.
Sales and Marketing:
connect with local business partners, grow your network and develop lasting relationships.
Financial Control and Profitability:
understand the financial mechanics of a successful business, including cost control and interpreting profit and loss statements.
Operations and Logistics:
learn how to manage a fleet, plan strategically, and drive performance.
Leadership and Development:
take the lead in mentoring, training, and developing your own team - with the opportunity to manage and promote others as you grow.

jobs.title: Inventory Specialist
jobs.desc:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
About The Role
The Inventory Specialist is a key role within the Site Supply Chain team, responsible for ensuring effective inventory governance, optimization, and financial control across onsite operations, external warehouse locations, and the wider end-to-end supply chain.
Operating in a regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, the role is accountable for maintaining inventory accuracy, minimizing inventory-related financial risk, driving working capital improvements, and supporting robust material flow from supplier through to customer.
The Inventory Controller plays a critical role in balancing customer service, inventory investment, compliance requirements, and operational efficiency by providing analytics, governance, and leadership for inventory performance across the site and external warehouse network.
Role Description
The Inventory Specialist will lead inventory management activities across raw materials, packaging components, work-in-progress, and finished goods inventory held onsite and at external warehouse locations.
The role is responsible for ensuring strong inventory governance, maintaining inventory accuracy, driving inventory optimization initiatives, and managing inventory-related financial performance. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Warehouse Operations, Customer Service, and external logistics partners to improve inventory health, reduce waste, support working capital objectives, and enhance end-to-end supply chain performance.
The position serves as the site's subject matter expert for inventory management and will lead initiatives relating to inventory reduction, slow-moving and obsolete inventory management, inventory reconciliation, master data integrity, and continuous improvement projects.
Key Responsibilities
Lead inventory governance activities across onsite operations and external warehouse locations, ensuring inventory accuracy, visibility, and control throughout the end-to-end supply chain.
Manage the site's Slow Moving and Obsolete Inventory (SLOB) process, including reporting, analysis, stakeholder engagement, action tracking, and governance reviews to minimize write-offs and improve working capital performance.
Partner closely with Finance to monitor inventory valuation, inventory provisions, write-offs, inventory reserves, cost optimization opportunities, and inventory-related financial risks.
Develop, monitor, and report inventory KPIs including inventory turns, inventory aging, stock accuracy, SLOB performance, cycle count compliance, expiry management, working capital performance, and service level impacts.
Lead inventory optimization initiatives across raw materials, packaging components, work-in-progress, and finished goods inventory, identifying opportunities to reduce excess inventory while maintaining customer service and production continuity.
Drive continuous improvement projects focused on inventory reduction, process simplification, data quality, planning parameter optimization, warehouse efficiency, and supply chain performance.
Monitor inventory at risk including expiring, excess, blocked, restricted, quarantine, rejected, and obsolete materials, ensuring timely disposition decisions and risk mitigation actions are implemented.
Conduct regular Gemba walks and process reviews to identify inventory-related issues, process inefficiencies, compliance gaps, and continuous improvement opportunities.
Support inventory-related audits, investigations, deviations, CAPAs, and compliance activities while ensuring adherence to GMP, GDP, EHS, financial control requirements, and site procedures.
Collaborate with Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Warehouse Operations, Quality, Finance, Customer Service, and external partners to balance inventory investment, operational requirements, and customer service objectives.
Maintain and continuously improve inventory management processes, reporting tools, master data governance, SOPs, work instructions, and training materials.
Support business continuity and risk management activities by identifying inventory-related risks, supply constraints, capacity limitations, material availability issues, and opportunities for supply chain resilience.

Collaborate with other customer support teams to resolve complex issues

Identify trends in customer issues and propose improvements to support processes

As a Tier 2 Technical Support Associate, you'll be at the heart of our global connectivity mission. Your day will be dynamic, and purpose driven. Each interaction is an opportunity to make a tangible difference in someone's ability to connect, learn, and grow.

Amazon Leo Global Operations is part of the Worldwide Consumer team. Our team fosters a collaborative environment where you will work with regional and local operations to develop business models, partnerships, and fixed service operations.

Experience working directly with end customers to resolve technical issues related to internet service, network connectivity, or end customer equipment

Regularly monitors the communication network between stakeholders.

Identifies business opportunities for the organisation;
Demonstrates financial awareness;

Degree in Civil Engineering. Masters would be an advantage.

jobs.title: Localization Engineer (With language Skills)
jobs.desc:
Role Summary
We are seeking an innovative and technically minded Globalization Engineer (Language Specialist) to join our Globalization Engineering team.
This role combines deep linguistic expertise with technology, automation, AI innovation, and process optimization to help deliver exceptional multilingual customer experiences across global markets. The successful candidate will play a critical role in driving AI adoption, redesigning localization workflows & Quality Processes, automating manual processes, managing linguistic assets, and ensuring the highest standards of language quality across products, content, and customer-facing experiences.
This position is ideal for an individual who is passionate about languages, technology, artificial intelligence, and operational excellence, and who wants to help shape the future of AI-enabled localization and globalization.
This is a Hybrid position located in Ireland. You may be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis. We are only considering candidates in Ireland and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
Position Details
About The Role
AI, Automation & Innovation
Drive the adoption of AI-powered localization technologies and workflows.
Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Machine Translation, Large Language Models (LLMs), and automation technologies to improve scalability, quality, and efficiency.
Evaluate emerging AI solutions and recommend innovative approaches to improve multilingual customer experiences.
Design and implement process improvements that reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery.
Develop and support automation solutions using scripting, integrations, and workflow technologies.
Contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled globalization and localization engineering practices.
Language Quality & Linguistic Excellence
Serve as a linguistic subject matter expert for one or more European languages.
Conduct linguistic quality assurance (LQA) activities and drive continuous quality improvement initiatives.
Define and maintain language quality standards, style guides, terminology, and best practices.
Ensure multilingual content is linguistically accurate, culturally appropriate, and aligned with brand standards.
Partner with stakeholders to resolve linguistic challenges and improve localization outcomes.
Linguistic Assets & AI Language Resources
Own and manage critical linguistic assets used across localization and AI initiatives.
Curate, develop, maintain, and govern:
Terminology databases
Translation memories
Taxonomies
Ontologies
Style guides
Language standards
AI evaluation datasets
Establish governance processes that ensure consistency, quality, reusability, and scalability of language resources.
Support the development of multilingual language assets that improve AI performance and customer experiences.
About You
Required Skills
Native or near-native proficiency in at least one European language.
Strong linguistic expertise and understanding of localization best practices.
Experience working in localization engineering, Localization QA, language technology, globalization, content operations, or a related field.
Experience with Localization Management Systems (TMS) and localization technologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Demonstrated experience improving workflows and operational processes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively in a global and highly collaborative environment.
Passion for technology, innovation, AI, language quality, and customer experience.
Preferred Skills
AI & Emerging Technology
Experience using Generative AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies.
Prompt engineering experience.
Experience evaluating AI-generated multilingual content.
Knowledge of AI governance, AI quality evaluation, and Responsible AI principles.
Familiarity with AI agents, autonomous workflows, and agent orchestration concepts.
Understanding of AI knowledge systems.
Automation & Technical Skills
Python scripting and automation experience.
Experience working with REST APIs and system integrations.
Knowledge of JSON, XML, and data exchange formats.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub and software development practices.
Experience with Power Automate, Logic Apps, workflow automation platforms, or equivalent technologies.
Basic understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
Localization Technology
Experience with localization platforms such as XTM, Smartling, Phrase, MemoQ, Trados, or similar solutions.
Understanding of Internationalization (i18n) principles and experience in guiding development best practice.
Knowledge of translation memory, terminology management, machine translation, and localization automation.
Experience supporting multilingual AI systems and language data management initiatives.
Key Competencies
We Are Looking For Candidates Who Demonstrate
A passion for languages and linguistic quality.
Technically minded with a Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI and emerging technologies.
Strong technical aptitude and systems thinking.
Analytical and data-driven decision making.
Continuous improvement mindset.
Innovation and problem-solving capability.
Customer-centric thinking.
Effective stakeholder engagement and collaboration skills.
Ability to influence change and drive adoption of new technologies.
Company Overview
McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.
Company Benefits And Perks
We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.
We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Accelerator / Security
jobs.desc:
Staff Software Engineer | AI Accelerator / Security | Cork, Ireland
A global technology leader in high-performance computing is hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join their specialised product security team.
AI accelerator cards provide the backbone of modern AI infrastructure, shifting workloads away from generic processors onto specialised NPU cores to deliver faster execution, lower latency, and reduced power consumption. Because these systems process critical user models and data, end-to-end hardware and firmware security is essential.
In this role, you will define security architectures, evaluate third-party components, establish secure device provisioning processes, and collaborate with industry partners to ensure these cutting-edge accelerator platforms meet rigorous security standards.
Key Responsibilities
Security Requirements & Architecture:
Define and document security requirements for all hardware components on the AI accelerator card.
Platform Management & Attestation:
Establish mechanisms for secure communication between the Board Management Controller (BMC) and platform-management services (including Redfish, SPDM, and PLDM interactions). Define processes for Platform Root of Trust (PRoT) attestation, evidence collection, and measurement verification.
Factory Provisioning & Lifecycle Security:
Design protocols, test plans, and production-line validation systems for provisioning keys, certificates, device identities, and configuration data in manufacturing environments.
Vendor & Standards Representation:
Serve as a security representative in industry forums (OCP, CCC, IETF RATS) focusing on attestation protocols and interoperability. Evaluate third-party vendor components against internal security bars.
Hands-on Security & Code Review:
Review C-based firmware running on discrete components and write Python-based tools for test automation, protocol validation, and provisioning utilities.
Critical Requirements
Education & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years in product security (Master’s/PhD research experience considered).
Hardware & Hardware Security:
In-depth knowledge of physical component security on accelerator cards (BMC, PRoT, flash devices, PCIe switches including ACS), alongside boot-chain security, firmware authentication, and key/certificate management lifecycles.
Risk & Architecture:
Proven track record conducting security risk assessments on complex discrete systems and drafting clear security specifications.
Software & Scripting:
Strong capability in reviewing low-level C firmware and proficient in Python for automation and tool development.
Communication:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and external industry representation.
Desirable Skills
Master’s degree with a focus on Information/Hardware Security.
Deep familiarity with MCTP, SPDM, PLDM, and Redfish protocols.
Practical experience implementing standards from the Open Compute Project (OCP), Confidential Computing Consortium (CCC), or IETF RATS (e.g., EAT tokens).
Knowledge of post-quantum cryptography applications in attestation, as well as secure debug and RMA flows.
Background working directly on AI accelerator cards or server-grade hardware security systems.

As Project Manager, you'll take ownership of projects from award through to completion, bringing design, fabrication, logistics and site teams together so the right steel and modules arrive at the right place, in the right sequence, with the right paperwork behind them.
You'll be working on projects where a late drawing, missed variation or poorly planned delivery doesn't just create an awkward phone call — it can hold up a factory, a site crew and an entire programme.
Your job is to see those problems coming.
What you'll be doing
You'll have ownership of your projects rather than simply being responsible for updating a programme.
That means getting scope and drawings locked down before fabrication starts, working closely with engineers and detailers, keeping production moving and making sure site teams have what they need before the steel or modules arrive.
You'll keep a close eye on cost, programme and risk, dealing with changes before they become disputes and keeping clients informed when decisions need to be made.
You'll also work with subcontractors, suppliers and logistics teams, making sure everyone understands what is required and when.
And when the project is finished, you'll make sure it actually gets finished, variations agreed, costs reconciled, handover documentation complete and the lessons from the job passed back into the next estimate.
The projects
This isn't a role where you'll spend your time managing the same type of building over and over again.
You'll see structural steel, cladding and modular/offsite construction across industrial, agricultural, sports and volumetric projects, with work extending across Ireland, the UK and Europe.
Some projects will be won and delivered quickly. Others will have more moving parts, multiple trades and plenty of opportunity for something to go wrong.
That's what makes the role important.
You'll be the person joining the dots between what was sold, what was designed, what is being fabricated and what eventually arrives on site.
What you'll bring
You'll already understand what it takes to deliver a construction project rather than simply administer one.
Ideally, you'll have experience managing structural steel, cladding, modular or offsite projects from award through to erection and handover.
You'll be comfortable reading fabrication drawings, understanding programmes and cost reports, challenging information that doesn't look right and having conversations with clients when scope or programme changes.
Experience managing variations, subcontractors and logistics is important, as is an understanding of CE marking, quality records and project handover documentation.
Most importantly, you'll be someone who can walk into a problem early, understand what is causing it and get the right people around the table before it becomes a much bigger one.
Why this role?
You'll have genuine influence over the outcome of the projects you manage.
You're not simply maintaining a spreadsheet while someone else makes the important decisions. You'll be working between the office, factory and site, seeing how decisions made during design and planning eventually affect fabrication and erection.
You'll also be joining a specialist business with decades of experience in steel and light-gauge construction, with established fabrication and modular capabilities behind you.
If you enjoy taking something complicated, bringing the moving parts together and eventually standing back to see the finished building on site, this is a role where you'll see the result of your work.
Interested?
If you've delivered structural steel, modular or offsite projects and you're ready for a role where you can genuinely own the outcome, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply now or get in touch for a confidential conversation about the project, the business and what the role could look like.

jobs.title: Material Planner
jobs.desc:
Material Planner
Join our dynamic team as a Material Planner and play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless supply chain operations essential to our innovative drug development and manufacturing processes. In this critical position, you'll drive the planning, procurement, and release of raw materials to support clinical trials and commercial production, directly impacting patient health worldwide. If you are passionate about precision, efficiency, and making a difference in the life sciences sector, this is your opportunity to contribute your expertise and grow within a forward-thinking organization.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage Material Requirements Planning (MRP) in SAP aligned with the Master Production Schedule to meet operational needs.
Convert purchase requisitions into purchase orders and monitor supplier invoicing and payments.
Oversee end-to-end inventory management, including safety stock, expiry, FIFO/FEFO, and lead times.
Issue quarterly supplier forecasts and coordinate with stakeholders on material readiness.
Maintain accurate SAP master data for all material components.
Resolve aging receipts, schedule conflicts, and exceptions proactively to ensure timely delivery.
Participate in global review meetings, performance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Generate KPIs to evaluate supplier performance and support the development of cost-saving strategies.
Facilitate cross-functional communication through meetings and reports to uphold schedule adherence.
Lead or contribute to projects focused on lean manufacturing and operational excellence.
Required Skills:
Strong experience with SAP in a supply chain planning or purchasing environment.
Proven ability to manage end-to-end materials planning and inventory processes.
Excellent analytical skills, with familiarity in data visualization tools like Power BI (desirable).
Demonstrated knowledge of GMP environments and pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills to engage vendors and cross-functional teams effectively.
Results-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
Ability to develop and implement efficient planning processes that align with company goals.
Preferred Education and Experience:
Honor's Degree (NFQ level 7) in Supply Chain Management or related Business discipline.
Supply Chain Certification such as APICS (preferred).
Minimum 2 years relevant supply chain experience, ideally within the pharmaceutical or GMP industry.
Experience with project management or lean methodologies (desirable).
Proven track record of managing direct material categories, especially chemicals and Single Use Technologies (highly desirable).
Take the next step in your career and apply today to become a vital part of our mission to deliver life-changing medicines. Your expertise can help us ensure the right materials are in the right place at the right time, making a real difference for patients worldwide.
Are you currently eligible to work in Ireland? As this is a contract opportunity, you will need to hold a Stamp 1G or
Stamp 4 visa to apply.
Apply via this advert or contact
Siobhan Cummins
on 021 4777329 if you have any questions about this role.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.desc:
PE Global Recruitment is currently recruiting for an experienced Civil/Structural Project Manager to join a major Tier 1 civil engineering contractor delivering a high-profile motorway project in Cork.
This is a senior site-based position with responsibility for the delivery of significant civil and structural elements across the project. The successful candidate will oversee works including bridge structures, retaining walls, reinforced concrete structures, precast elements, culverts, earthworks interfaces and associated motorway infrastructure.
Reporting to the Contract Manager/Senior Project Manager, you will take responsibility for the safe, technical, commercial and operational delivery of your section of works. You will lead engineering, supervisory and subcontractor teams while ensuring works are delivered in line with programme, specification, quality and safety requirements.
This is an excellent opportunity to join a major long-term infrastructure project with one of Ireland's leading Tier 1 contractors.
Key Responsibilities
Manage the delivery of civil and structural works across a major motorway project.
Lead site engineering, supervisory and subcontractor teams.
Coordinate the construction of bridges, retaining structures, reinforced concrete works, precast elements, culverts and associated civil infrastructure.
Manage construction activities from planning and mobilisation through to completion and handover.
Ensure works are delivered safely and in accordance with project specifications, approved drawings and TII requirements.
Develop and manage construction programmes, short-term plans and delivery strategies.
Coordinate labour, plant, materials, subcontractors and site logistics to achieve programme milestones.
Provide technical leadership across structural and civil engineering activities.
Review construction methodologies, RAMS, temporary works requirements and engineering solutions.
Manage interfaces between permanent works, temporary works, earthworks, structures and wider motorway construction activities.
Identify technical and construction risks and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are implemented.
Oversee temporary works including falsework, formwork, propping and associated temporary structures.
Maintain appropriate temporary works registers, inspections and permit systems.
Ensure temporary works are designed, checked, constructed and authorised in accordance with project procedures.
Implement and maintain project quality systems including ITPs, inspections and construction records.
Ensure works are completed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications and client requirements.
Monitor progress against programme and identify potential delays or construction constraints.
Work closely with commercial teams to identify variations, contractual changes and potential compensation events.
Support cost control and commercial performance across the assigned works.
Liaise with the client, designers, subcontractors and other key project stakeholders.
Lead site safety inspections and ensure appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permits and safe systems of work are in place.
Drive high standards of safety, quality and delivery throughout the project.
Experience & Qualifications
Essential
Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
Strong experience delivering major civil engineering or structural construction projects.
Previous Project Manager, Structures Agent, Senior Agent or similar project delivery experience.
Strong knowledge of reinforced concrete structures, bridge works and temporary works.
Experience managing engineering teams, supervisors and specialist subcontractors.
Strong understanding of construction programming, project controls and commercial management.
Ability to manage complex construction interfaces and multiple work packages.
Strong knowledge of health and safety and quality requirements within major civil engineering projects.
Highly Desirable
Previous experience delivering major motorway, roads or transportation infrastructure projects.
Temporary Works Coordinator qualification.
Experience working to TII specifications and standards.
Knowledge of NEC contracts.
Chartered Engineer status or working towards chartership.
Experience across major infrastructure, transportation, marine, energy or heavy civil engineering projects.
Package & Benefits
A highly competitive salary and benefits package is available, including:
8% employer pension contribution.
Private health insurance.
Dental plan.
26 days annual leave with increases based on service.
2 additional wellbeing days annually.
Paid maternity and paternity leave.
Company vehicle where applicable.
Excellent learning and development opportunities.
Strong opportunities for long-term career progression within a major Tier 1 contractor.
This is a permanent opportunity to join one of Ireland's leading civil engineering contractors and play a key role in the delivery of a major, high-profile motorway infrastructure project.

jobs.title: Christmas Customer Assistant
jobs.desc:
Please note, this role is located in IRELAND
Ready to make someone's day this Christmas? Join Boots as a Seasonal Customer Assistant and be part of something special.
The festive season at Boots is one of the busiest and most exciting times of the year, and we're looking for enthusiastic people to help create brilliant experiences for our customers when it matters most.
About The Opportunity
As a Seasonal Customer Assistant, you'll be at the heart of the action, helping customers find the perfect gift, discover great offers and get what they need for the celebrations ahead.
You'll be the friendly face customers turn to for advice and support, creating feel-good moments that make a real difference and keep them coming back all year round.
This is an important role where you'll help deliver a great experience for our customers. It's also a fast-paced and active role where priorities can change quickly throughout the day.
You won't just be helping customers on the shop floor. You'll also support deliveries, replenish stock, and help keep the store looking its best.
Working in store is a real team effort, so you'll need to be flexible and ready to step into different areas to keep things running smoothly. You'll feel good knowing you're playing your part and enjoy a strong sense of teamwork and fun as everyone pulls together during our busiest season.
If you enjoy helping people, staying busy and being part of a supportive team, this could be the role for you.
This is a temporary role, with the potential for longer-term opportunities depending on local availability.
You Will
What you'll be doing
Welcome customers, understand their needs and help them find the right products, gifts, services and offers.
Create memorable customer experiences through friendly, personalised service.
Help customers complete purchases using tills and self-checkouts.
Replenish stock and keep shelves full
Support deliveries and help organise stock in the stockroom.
Keep the store and shopping areas look their best.
Work across different areas of the store and support your team wherever help is needed.
What You'll Need To Have (our Must-haves)
Available to work Bank Holidays including Black Friday week and weekend, Cyber Monday, Christmas Eve, St Stephen's Day and New Year's Day.
Customer-focused — enjoys talking to people and helping customers have a great experience.
Team player — supports others and cares about team success.
Operations ready — comfortable balancing customer service with stock, fulfilment and shop floor tasks.
Proactive attitude — sees what needs doing and takes ownership.
Resilient — stays positive and focused during busy periods.
Energy and stamina — keeps energy high throughout long, active shifts.
Confident asking questions — asks for help when needed to get things right.
Comfortable with technology — learns new systems and confidently uses handheld devices, tills and self-checkouts.
It would be great if you also have
Previous experience in a retail or customer-facing environment.
Familiarity with Boots products and services.
Where your brilliance can take you
You’ll receive industry-recognised training and build valuable experience along the way. You may go on to explore more in Retail, Pharmacy, Beauty or Opticians, or ultimately progress into management. There are plenty of paths to follow for you to become brilliant with Boots —you can read some of our
colleagues stories here.
Rewards designed for you
Discretionary Christmas bonus
Generous employee discount (After 1 month’s service)
Access to our One Hub discount platform
There’s lots more in our benefits and discounts, MyBoosts – there to give you that little lift in your everyday. Find out more at
boots.jobs/ireland
Exclusions may apply; eligible roles only. Please note that any salary estimates provided on third-party sites are not endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.
A Bit About Us
At Boots, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, creating a place where everyone feels welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. We believe that when our people feel valued and included, they thrive, so we're committed to creating a brilliant Boots for our people so they can make a difference for our customers and colleagues every time.
What’s next?
If you apply, our team will be in touch to let you know the outcome of your application or to arrange next steps. Where a role is advertised as full-time, we are open to discussing part-time and job share options.
If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you be at your best.
We hope to hear from you soon.
Be brilliant with Boots.

MongoDB is seeking an Engineering Manager to join the Atlas Organization. The organization is responsible for building MongoDB Atlas, our database-as-a-service offering and fastest growing product.
Atlas allows users to deploy fault-tolerant, secure, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in just minutes. The team builds Atlas Data Federation, a distributed query engine that lets users query data across Atlas Clusters and cloud object storage through a unified service. The team also builds Atlas Online Archive which allows customers to move data from Atlas Clusters into fully managed cloud object storage while preserving a seamless query experience across hot and cold datasets.
We are forming a new Atlas Data Federation & Archiving team in the Dublin area. The Engineering Manager who fills this position will be pivotal in growing that team.

jobs.desc:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality.
Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health.
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Job Title:
Software Engineer II – Stratus HLS AI/LLM Systems
Location:
Cork, Ireland
Reports to:
Engineering Group Director, Stratus HLS
Job Overview
Cadence is seeking a Software Engineer to join the Stratus High Level Synthesis (HLS) engineering team in Cork. This role will contribute to building AI-powered tools that help engineers get more value from one of the EDA industry’s leading high-level synthesis platforms.
In this role, you will write production-quality C++ and Python code, design and test LLM-based agent systems, and develop IDE tooling. You will work alongside experienced software engineers in a technically deep, fast-moving environment. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to strengthen core software engineering skills while gaining cutting-edge experience in applied AI systems.
Job Responsibilities
Implement AI agent features that leverage LLMs for tasks such as code interpretation, code completion and code generation within the Stratus HLS environment.
Build and test agentic pipelines that connect Stratus tools and APIs to deliver context-aware guidance to users.
Apply prompt engineering techniques and contribute to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines to improve the accuracy and relevance of AI responses.
Author and maintain Skills, including slash commands for AI coding agents such as Claude Code and openCode, encoding Stratus domain knowledge into reusable workflows.
Design Skills that orchestrate multi-step agentic flows, combining tool calls, context retrieval and structured prompts to automate complex Stratus operations reliably and repeatably.
Evaluate emerging LLM models and frameworks, including Claude, GPT-4 and open-source alternatives, and prototype their application to HLS workflows.
Instrument AI agent behaviour and contribute to quality metrics that track accuracy, latency and user experience.
Write, review and maintain clean, well-tested C++ code within the Stratus codebase, following established engineering standards and design patterns.
Read feature specifications and translate them into implementation plans, data structures and modular software designs.
Develop VS Code extension components in TypeScript/JavaScript that surface AI agent capabilities directly in the engineer’s IDE.
Write unit and integration tests, submit code through the Stratus regression system, and resolve failures to ensure every commit meets quality standards before release.
Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback to strengthen both the codebase and personal development.
Participate in technical design reviews, contributing ideas and asking questions that sharpen the team’s understanding of problems.
Collaborate with senior engineers and domain experts to understand HLS workflows and apply that knowledge to well-engineered solutions.
Stay current with LLM and AI agent research, prototype new techniques and share findings with the engineering team.
Write clear engineering documentation, including design notes, API documentation and inline comments, so code decisions are understandable and maintainable over time.
Job Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field with 2+ years of relevant industry experience; or
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field with 1+ year of relevant industry experience.
Solid programming skills in C++ or another compiled, statically typed language, with an understanding of memory management, performance trade-offs and code organisation.
Proficiency in Python, including scripting for data processing, automation or ML workflows.
Experience working with LLM APIs, AI agent frameworks or machine learning tools through academic projects, internships or industry experience.
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms and fundamental software design principles such as modularity, separation of concerns and testability.
Ability to read specifications and break them into well-structured implementation tasks with clear interfaces and testable units.
Enthusiastic and motivated, with a genuine interest in writing good software and learning how complex systems work.
Collaborative team player who communicates clearly, accepts feedback constructively and asks for help when needed.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where both requirements and underlying technologies evolve frequently.
Additional Skills/Preferences
Experience writing Skills or slash commands for AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, openCode or other prompt-driven automation frameworks.
Familiarity with VS Code extension development or other IDE plugin frameworks, including Language Server Protocol and Debug Adapter Protocol.
Exposure to Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools, High Level Synthesis (HLS) or hardware design workflows.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases such as Chroma, Pinecone or Weaviate, or embedding pipelines.
Exposure to fine-tuning or instruction-tuning LLMs on domain-specific datasets.
Familiarity with Tcl scripting or scripted automation.
Basic understanding of cloud ML inference infrastructure, including AWS, GCP or Azure.
Open-source contributions to AI/ML or developer tooling projects.
Additional Information
The Stratus software engineering team is a collaborative group of engineers responsible for core HLS functionality, verification flows and increasingly AI-powered user experiences. The team places a strong emphasis on engineering craft, including readable code, thorough testing and well-considered design. New engineers benefit from close mentorship and regular pairing with senior team members.
Senior software engineers who provide mentorship and code review.
HLS algorithm and compiler engineers who provide domain expertise.
QA and release engineering teams who own the regression infrastructure.
A broader Cadence AI platform team sharing LLM infrastructure and tooling across product lines.
Primary languages: C++, Tcl, Python
AI/ML frameworks: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, openCode
IDE tooling: VS Code Extension API, Language Server Protocol
Version control: SVN, Git, Perforce
Build & CI: Internal Cadence regression and release systems
Documentation: Confluence, internal wiki

25 days holiday per year

5 days paid time to volunteer to give back to our communities

BACKGROUND
Tesco is a values-led business and we are committed to building a better Tesco and to support our colleagues in Serving Ireland’s Shoppers a Little Better Everyday. We aspire to create an emotional connection with our customers and colleagues and to help to make their lives more manageable and enjoyable. Tesco Ireland is committed to developing individuals' talents and supporting professional development as a dynamic business that values people with strong leadership skills and an entrepreneurial attitude.
THE ROLE

Lead and coach your team to deliver the best Shopping Trip for customers by ensuring great service, standards and availability
Deliver all key performance indicators for your departments
Lead a team, making decisions every day that support them to do their jobs
Deliver the training plan, ensuring all colleagues receive quality training, are validated to do their job and have an up to date training card

Coach my team, giving them the confidence to call out  behavioural issues and improve the shopping trip for customers
Creates an environment that encourages innovation and personal growth
Role models a culture where customers love to shop and colleagues love to work
Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.
You will be responsible for
Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do.
Get to know your customers and serve them with pride.
Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times.
Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition.
Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times.
Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes.
Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines.
Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments.
You will need
EXPERIENCE
Must have previous management experience
For the ‘Line Manager’ role you have a demonstrated track record of:
Being passionate about delivering  the right way for customers and colleagues
Being adaptable and agile in your thinking
Delivering key objectives in a fast paced environment
Being the ‘Go To’ person for all queries for your department
Shaping and influencing at the most senior level
Previous Retail Experience preferred
LEADERSHIP SKILLS & STYLE
You make time to build strong relationships with colleagues inside and outside of my store. I work collaboratively with my team to deliver results
You are warm and welcoming in every interaction with colleagues and customers – putting people at the heart of everything that I do. I take time to see hear and recognise others. Colleagues see me being myself, sharing my passion and enthusiasm
You use energy and resilience to keep momentum going when working in challenging environments. I make tough decisions when there is no right answer, staying true to my personal values
Your colleagues see me doing the right things when things are going well and when times are tough. I know how to be at my best and inspire confidence in those around me
You encourage others to think differently, providing an environment where creativity and new ideas are welcomed. I am keen to help deliver new initiatives, providing feedback on how they could be further improved
A humble leader who lives the Tesco’s values
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to:
Competitive Salary from €37,500
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2
nd
Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.

jobs.title: Contract Process Analyst – Supply Chain & Operations Strategy
jobs.desc:
About the role
TechniStrat Consulting Limited is a boutique advisory firm specialising in Engineering, Automation and Supply Chain strategy for multinational life sciences and manufacturing clients across Europe.
We are seeking a contract Process Analyst to support client-facing engagements in supply chain strategy, distribution network design, logistics optimisation and operational transformation. You will turn large, complex operational datasets into clear insight, build the models and dashboards that underpin our recommendations, and work directly alongside client teams to map, measure and improve their processes.
Key responsibilities
Data and analytics
•     Collect, cleanse and integrate large operational datasets from client ERP, WMS, TMS and planning systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Manhattan, Blue Yonder).
•     Design and build scalable data models to support network, inventory, transport and cost analysis.
•     Develop interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards that track KPIs such as service level, cost-to-serve, inventory turns, OTIF and warehouse productivity.
•     Write and optimise SQL queries and DAX measures for performance on large data volumes.
Supply chain and network analysis
•     Build baseline models of current-state distribution networks, flows and costs.
•     Run scenario and sensitivity analysis to support distribution network design, site selection and 3PL / outsourcing decisions.
•     Analyse logistics performance to identify optimisation opportunities in transport, warehousing and inventory.
Process improvement and transformation
•     Map current- and future-state processes (SIPOC, swimlanes, value stream maps) through workshops and site visits.
•     Quantify gaps, root causes and improvement opportunities, and build supporting business cases.
•     Track benefits realisation and programme KPIs through implementation.
Client delivery
•     Translate analysis into clear, executive-ready insights, charts and presentations.
•     Work directly with client stakeholders from shop floor to senior leadership.
•     Maintain rigorous documentation of data sources, assumptions and model logic.
Required experience and skills
•     3–5 years in a process, data or business analyst role within supply chain, logistics, operations or consulting.
•     Strong hands-on experience with
Power BI
(data modelling, Power Query, DAX) and
Tableau
(calculated fields, LOD expressions, dashboard design).
•     Proven experience building and working with
large data models
— millions of rows, multiple source systems, star-schema design and performance tuning.
•     Advanced SQL; strong Excel skills.
•     Solid understanding of supply chain fundamentals: distribution networks, warehousing, transport, inventory and demand/supply planning.
•     Experience with process mapping and improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma or similar).
•     Ability to explain complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences, in writing and in person.
•     Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Data Analytics, Business or a related field.
•     Fluent English; Resident and eligible to work in Ireland / EU. Work Permit support will not be considered.
Desirable experience
•     Management consulting or client-facing project experience.
•     Life sciences, medical device or regulated (GMP/GxP) manufacturing and distribution environments.
•     Network design and optimisation tools (e.g. Coupa Supply Chain Guru / LLamasoft, AIMMS, anyLogistix).
•     Python or R for data preparation, analysis or modelling.
•     Cloud data platforms (Azure, Snowflake, Databricks) or Microsoft Fabric.
•     3PL selection, outsourcing or logistics tender support.
•     Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent; APICS / ASCM certification.
•     Additional European languages.
Personal attributes
•     Analytical and curious — you question the data and look for the story behind it.
•     Commercially minded — you connect analysis to cost, service and risk.
•     Self-directed and able to deliver with minimal supervision in a small, fast-moving team.
•     Confident with clients, comfortable leading workshops and site walk-throughs.
•     Organised and detail-oriented, with high standards for accuracy and documentation.
What we offer
•     Competitive day rate, depending on experience.
•     Exposure to high-impact supply chain programmes for multinational life sciences and manufacturing clients.
•     Close collaboration with senior practitioners with extensive industry leadership experience.
•     Flexible working arrangements.
How to apply
Send your CV and a short cover note, including your day rate expectation, availability and examples of Power BI / Tableau work you have delivered (screenshots or anonymised samples welcome).

Advancing possibilities for a brighter tomorrow

As a Graduate Systems Engineer, you will support the development of complex active implantable medical devices while building your knowledge of systems engineering. Participate in cross-functional design reviews and technical discussions, contributing analysis and ideas with support from the wider team.
Collaborate with Electrical, Software, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Quality and Regulatory colleagues to support product development activities.

Education & Experience

Graduated within the past two years or currently in the final year of university.
Relevant work experience or completion of a co-op program.
Eligibility to work in Ireland.
Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the initiative to contribute in a collaborative environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an interest in understanding how complex systems work.

Enthusiastic, proactive approach to learning and problem-solving.

Indirect Procurement

.

Develop sourcing plans and category roadmaps for assigned areas of spend.
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders throughout sourcing initiatives, ensuring projects are delivered effectively and on time.

Supplier & Commercial Management

Support supplier negotiations and commercial discussions to achieve competitive pricing and favorable terms.
Monitor supplier performance and work with stakeholders to address issues and identify opportunities for improvement.
Maintain strong working relationships with key suppliers and support ongoing supplier management activities.
Identify opportunities to improve supplier consolidation, service levels, commercial terms, and overall value.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related field.
8 + years’ experience in indirect procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management.
Strong understanding of indirect procurement categories, sourcing, supplier management, and commercial negotiations.
Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work at pace, manage multiple priorities, and translate business needs into effective procurement strategies.
Experience using spend analytics, dashboards, procurement technology, and AI-enabled tools to identify opportunities and improve efficiency.

jobs.title: School meal worker (Hot Drop) - Ballygarvan GAA
jobs.desc:
A Little Bit About Us
Looking for a job that actually makes a difference - and fits into your day-to-day routine?
At The Lunch Bag, we deliver healthy, hot school meals to children across Ireland. We're the country’s leading school meal provider, and we’re on a mission to help children build healthy habits for life.
We’re changing children’s lives, one lunch at a time. Are you flexible, bubbly, and keen to bring a little extra joy to the school day? We’re looking for people who want to help us keep driving forward and doing something great. Bonus? You’re off when the schools are!
So, what’s the job?
We’re on the hunt for School Lunch Operatives – reliable, cheerful people who take pride in doing things right and bring a bit of warmth to every school day.
Think of yourself as the final link in the lunch chain. All meals are prepared in our headquarters in Nenagh, Tipperary, and then delivered to the Hot Drop Locations. It’s from there that you’ll take over. Your duties will consist of heating the meals in the oven, loading them into vans and driving them to the schools.
If you’re a detail addict and thought this was a little vague, here’s a list for you:
Load pre-packaged school meals into ovens.
Turn on oven and heat meals to specific temperature according to HACCP guidelines.
Unload ovens and load into vans.
Drive the lunches in a company vehicle to the local schools.
Ensure adequate stock levels.
Follow and maintain work and cleaning schedule.
Maintain temperature and cleaning records.
HACCP and Manual Handling Training will be provided.
What we’re looking for
Since you’ll be representing The Lunch Bag in schools, we’re looking for doers - people who are sound, good-natured, and genuinely care about doing a good job. Our values matter to us, and to keep improving the lives of children across the country, we need people who share that same goal.
We’re not asking for bodybuilders, but you do need to be able to lift 14kg boxes as part of the job. You may also need to climb some stairs – not every facility in Ireland has a lift
Working for children is really rewarding – their cute little faces can brighten your day... just don’t let them get hungry or they’ll turn into tiny monsters! So we’re looking for someone who can work quickly, stay calm under pressure, and still do things properly.
All you need is the ability to read English, have full clean Irish driving license, and heat each lunch with care.
We’re looking for cheerful people who like being out and about. Teleportation would make life easier, but until that arrives, we need drivers who are happy to take a roughly one-hour trip to deliver meals to local schools.
I still have questions actually…
No problem! We’re here to answer them.
When will I work?
This job is offered on a part-time basis, 5 hours a day, Monday through Friday! Typical hours of work are 08:30 to 13:30 with some flexibility required as start and finish times may be a little earlier or later.
Will I have to work all year long?
No! As schools close for the summer, we follow the academic calendar. As a result, you will work with us approx 183 days of the year and will have the rest off to enjoy some well-deserved rest! Our staff sign on to Social Welfare as Educational Sector Workers during the summer months.
What benefits do I get by joining The Lunch Bag?
Well, for starters - a genuinely supportive team who’ve got your back.
The role’s flexible, ideal if you’re looking to ease back into work or just want something steady during school terms.
How much is it paid?
It’s THE question everybody is asking! The same way we take care of the children in the schools, we take care of our people. You will earn €14.65 per hour – 50c above minimum wage.

jobs.title: Additive Design Engineer (Staff)
jobs.desc:
Hybrid fixed term contract role based in Carrigtwohill, Cork running until 31st December 2027
Create imaginative, thorough, and practical technical solutions that are key to successful product development. Through patent protection and invention disclosure, protect the technologies that are core to the long-term success of the business.
You will work with a highly creative design team in and out of the company to invent and develop innovative successful new product concepts.  Create smart, innovative solutions to mechanical design challenges. Conducts research in problem areas of considerable scope and complexity.
Evaluate and optimize concepts for mechanical function and manufacturability. Develop product designs and create prototypes from customer concepts and/or specs to test and validate ideas.
Through statistical techniques and engineering tools, determine design approaches and parameters and create feasibility studies on new designs. Lead design review meetings, while building a technology network, both internal and external.
While understanding other functions capabilities, communicate with suppliers, advanced manufacturing engineering and product development to resolve issues and optimize design for manufacturability and efficiency. Will ensure designs are cost efficient, manufacturable and reliable.
You will lead and contribute significantly in efforts to identify, determine product requirements, generate production drawings for parts and assemblies and develop and manage full product design documentation.
This position is accountable for achieving product performance and quality objectives, project planning and effective execution, as well as communicating program status and escalating issues when appropriate.
Independently determines and develops approach to resolving end customers product related issues, through problem solving and troubleshooting product design, product training and relationship building.
All other duties as assigned.
Bachelor Engineering Degree (Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Design, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Materials Science) with a minimum of 4 years or more experience.
Excellent interpersonal skills - able to express ideas and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.  Open minded- able to recognize good ideas.
Innovative thinker - able to envision new and better ways to do things.
Experience in executing complex problem-solving techniques related to design/technical issues. Good instincts and sound judgment for mechanical and structural design.
Good understanding of statistical tools and validation/verification techniques.
Excellent analytical skills, ability to plan, organize, and implement multiple concurrent tasks.
Be able to analyze and correct complex product and/or process issues and make decisions using independent judgement.
Good working knowledge of CAM/CAE computer systems, engineering materials and design, coating technologies, plastic part design and advanced manufacturing technologies. Fluent in 3D CAD with good working knowledge of Finite Element Analysis tools.
Be able to read and interpret complex engineering drawings and have a good understanding of geometrical dimensioning and tolerancing.
You will have the ability to work with and assemble small objects and component parts. Ability to operate small hand tools and inspection equipment.
PC Literate (word processing, spreadsheets, data base) and strong knowledge of project Management tools is essential.
Willingness to travel internationally for live surgery visits and global partner collaboration, and work on international assignments.
Ireland Pay Ranges:
Ireland: €54,000 - €90,000 EUR Annual
At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package.
If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.
Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

jobs.title: Civil Resident Engineers - Water
jobs.desc:
Company Description
Job Description
Start here. Grow here.
AECOM boasts an impressive and expansive Water Team operating across the globe; with approximately 700 water experts sitting in our UK and Ireland offices. We are constantly evolving to remain at the forefront of innovation, and we're on the lookout for talented, dedicated, and passionate individuals to join us.
Our Ireland Water Team are leading the way in delivering the most critical water infrastructure projects across the country through major national programmes for
Uisce Éireann
(Irish Water). AECOM is proud to have been supporting Uisce Eireann since the inception of its Resident Engineer programme seven years ago and are currently on the lookout for
Civil Resident Engineers
(Senior REs, REs & Assistant REs) to increase our existing team and support the delivery of Uisce Eireann’s Capital Investment Plan.
As a Resident Engineer you will work with Uisce Éireann framework providers to ensure each project is constructed to the specified quality standards. The work will involve major water and wastewater infrastructure and non-infrastructure projects, including new water and wastewater treatment plants and upgrades, pumping stations, water supply schemes, WwBG sewer rehab and reservoirs projects across all counties in the Republic of Ireland.
Reflecting Uisce Éireann and AECOM’s commitment to safety as a core value, you will be an ambassador for safety in this role. You will proactively improve the safety culture and implement all safety policies and standards on the construction projects.
Responsibilities include:
Lead the delivery of site-based infrastructure projects on behalf of Uisce Éireann, ensuring compliance with health & safety, quality, environmental, programme, and cost requirements.
Review and monitor Contractor documentation and performance, including HSQE submissions (RAMS, TMPs), CEMPs, quality plans, and adherence to contractual obligations.
Conduct regular site inspections, safety reviews, and quality audits, ensuring works are completed in accordance with specifications and approved proposals, and assist with incident investigations as required.
Supervise construction activities, maintain detailed project records, and support the coordination and monitoring of commissioning works to achieve timely project completion.
Administer commercial aspects of contracts, including assessment of interim and final accounts, variations, claims, and contractor performance against KPIs.
Develop and maintain effective communication with the Project Team, Employer’s Representative, Local Authorities, utility providers, landowners, and the public to ensure coordinated project delivery.
Why Join AECOM?
Impact:
We lead some of the largest infrastructure projects across the UK, Ireland, and globally. By joining us, you'll deliver designs that prioritise innovative and sustainable solutions, work on collaborative platforms and harness cutting-edge technology.
Growth:
We prioritise the professional growth of our team members from day one. We offer fast-track opportunities for development, making you a key member of a diverse, dynamic, and ever-expanding team.
Flexibility:
We believe careers should be built around people, not just projects. Whether you're looking to deepen a technical specialism, step into leadership, or explore new disciplines, we offer the flexibility, support, and career pathways to help you shape your own development.
If you're passionate about innovation and turning bold ideas into reality, we want to hear from you. If you’re based in Ireland (or open to relocating here) with technical experience in the water sector, we would be delighted to hear from you.
Qualifications

Opportunity to progress and develop your career within a busy four-star hotel.

jobs.desc:
Spare Parts Technician
Location: Barnahely, Ringaskiddy, Co. Cork (On-site)
Duration: 12-month contract
Hours: Two-shift pattern (7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Monday–Wednesday, and 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Thursday–Friday with an alternating Thursday handover)
Imagine your next project taking the lead in managing critical store operations and inventory for a global leader in innovative medicine, supported by a competitive 20% shift allowance with no weekend work or travel required.
Operates out of the Facilities Store and Maintenance Office as part of a 5-person team. The job holder is responsible for managing the inventory of spare parts and ensuring the efficient operation of the storage area. This role involves receiving, storing, and issuing spare parts while maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance with safety standards in accordance with J&J policies and standards.
roles and responsibilities
Storage and handling of Spare Parts and Consumables:
Ensure the Stores area is compliant with health & safety guidelines and ensure that any issues are highlighted in a timely manner. Ensure all Spare Parts are handled in accordance with health & safety guidelines. Ensure that the Stores area is kept clean and tidy at all times. Implement best practices with respect to the storage of spare parts and consumables.
Receiving and Inspection:
Accept deliveries from Main Warehouse daily. Check part against delivery paperwork, purchase order, and SAP to ensure the correct part has been delivered. If any parts are damaged, photographs are taken of the damaged parts and sent to purchasing. If certification is needed and has been received, it is stored with the spare part in its location. Complete the GR process in SAP, in accordance with TV-WI-39689.
Kit Preparation:
Ensure all kits are prepared and ready in a timely manner in accordance with the Maintenance PM and Calibration Schedule. Attend all meetings as appropriate with Maintenance Schedulers/Planners in relation to Work Order Planning & Execution and associated Spare Part availability. Support KPI targets for Kit availability.
Cycle Count:
Perform periodic cycle counts in accordance with TV-TEC-94802 & TV-WI-22478. Distribute cycle count reports to relevant stakeholders to keep them updated on inventory accuracy. Highlight significant findings, discrepancies, and recommended actions in these reports to facilitate informed decision making. Develop action plans to address any recurring discrepancies.
Documentation Management:
Ensure all documentation in relation to Spare Parts is stored in accordance with GMP. Maximize the use of electronic forms of documentation and storage in order to optimize the ease of document retrieval and navigation.
System Maintenance:
Ensure spare parts are set up in a timely manner for all new systems as per TV-WI-39358. Where a system is decommissioned, ensure the appropriate Spare Parts are written off the system. Ensure all changes to Spare Parts data are made in accordance with TV-WI-23221. Ensure all Spare Parts have the correct classification as per TV-TEC-94802.
Continuous Improvement:
Actively participate in continuous improvement projects which seek to further optimize the Spare Parts & Stores processes. Constantly seek to identify continuous improvement opportunities within the Spares & Stores processes.
Collaboration:
Actively participate in maintaining effective working relationships with Procurement Service Providers such as Eriks. Work closely with other departments to ensure timely availability of parts for maintenance and repair.
Other Duties:
Ensure that personal training requirements are completed in compliance with site and role requirements. Managing goods in and out, picking parts for maintenance, processing work orders, searching parts in the system, supporting breakdowns, accurate record-keeping, and managing spare part stock levels.
how to succeed
College leavers and warehouse-experienced candidates are considered with no strict prior experience required. Emphasizes a willingness to learn and develop, strong listening skills, and team alignment.
Good understanding of all stores procedures and operations.
Able to communicate openly, professionally, and honestly.
Experience in SAP and Spare Parts systems.
Working knowledge of GMP requirements.
Able to make logical decisions within their level of authority.
Showing initiative and continuously seeking improvement opportunities.
Ability to build relationships with teams across the organization.
Strong collaboration and influencing skills to partner effectively at all levels and across multiple groups.
Strong organization and prioritization skills.
Preferred related industry experience in healthcare, consumer goods, or electronics.
Preferred Six Sigma/LEAN certification, but not required.
Preferred communication skills.
Preferred procurement knowledge and vendor management skills.
Preferred business acumen.
Preferred working knowledge of GxP requirements and regulations.
