jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Customer Experience Technology
jobs.desc:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
Located out of our Cork Office - 2 days per week min in the office.
The Role:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
The Digital Office is a service-centric organization where our Business Capability Teams are directly accountable for the end-to-end business capabilities they enable.
We are looking for a Business Capability Owner (BCO) for our Consumer Customer Experience (CX) capability. In this role, you will be the strategic partner to our Global CX Business Unit, enabling the technology that supports millions of customer interactions across the globe.
You are accountable for the strategic "what" and "why" of the capability. You will manage the roadmap for self-service, agent tools, and omnichannel support.
In this pivotal role, you will be the driving force behind the strategic evolution and continuous optimization of our entire Customer Experience (CX) technology ecosystem. This mandate extends beyond mere maintenance; it requires a visionary approach to ensure that our current technological landscape not only meets but also anticipates future organizational demands.
Your core responsibility will be to ensure maximum scalability, resilience, and adaptability across all CX platforms and tools. This involves a deep-dive assessment of existing architecture, identifying bottlenecks and areas for modernization, and developing a comprehensive, multi-year technology roadmap.
This roadmap must be meticulously aligned with the overarching strategic objectives and anticipated growth trajectories of the business, ensuring our CX technology is a competitive differentiator rather than a constraint.
Furthermore, you will champion initiatives to integrate disparate systems, harness the power of emerging technologies (such as AI and advanced analytics) to personalize and streamline customer interactions, and establish robust governance frameworks for data integrity and security within the CX domain.
Ultimately, your leadership will guarantee that our technology foundation is robust, forward-looking, and perfectly positioned to support the delivery of world-class customer experiences at scale.
Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.
In this role you will be responsible for:
CX Strategy & Platform Vision: Define the 3-5 year roadmap for our B2C Service technology.
Operational Alignment: Bridge the gap between technology and the contact center floor. You will translate high-level business goals (e.g., reducing Average Handle Time, increasing First Contact Resolution) into digital features that make agents' lives easier.
Backlog & Prioritization: Own and prioritize the capability roadmap, strategically balancing operational excellence with the integration of next-generation CX technologies. You will ensure our stack remains future-proof by evaluating and implementing AI-driven support, intelligent chatbots, and advanced self-service architectures.
Business Value & ROI: Define and track the business value of your digital investments. You are accountable for proving how technology improves CSAT, NPS, and Operational Efficiency.
Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary advisor to the Head of Global CX and Operations Directors. You are the "voice of the business" within the Digital Office.
Partnership: Collaborate relentlessly with your Technology Lead (TL) partner to ensure the strategic vision is translated into a scalable, secure technical solution.
Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
Strategic Leadership: Proven experience as a Product Manager, Service Delivery Manager, BCO, or Digital Transformation Lead specifically within the Customer Service / Support domain.
Operational DNA: You have strong business acumen regarding how a Support Center functions. Ideally, you have worked in a Customer Service Center in the past (e.g., as an Operations Manager, Supervisor, or Process Lead) before moving into Digital/Product. You understand the pressure agents face.
Ecosystem Modernization: Proven track record of leading large-scale digital transformations within a global CX environment. You have experience navigating the complexities of scaling, upgrading, or evolving enterprise-level tech stacks to meet high-growth business demands.
B2C Scale: Experience working with high-volume, B2C consumer models (Retail, Consumer Electronics, FMCG). You understand the complexity of global warranties, returns (RMA), and technical troubleshooting.
Preferred Qualifications:
Platform Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Customer Service technology landscape (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Oracle Service, ServiceNow).
AI & Automation: Experience implementing chatbots, AI-assisted agent tools, or knowledge management systems.
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification.
Experience with Consumer Electronics support specifically (hardware + software troubleshooting).

We are currently on the lookout for a Senior Procurement Buyer to join our PGCS Procurement team.We are the concentrate team in PepsiCo (PGCS) working across the Beverage, Nutrition and Snacks categories to deliver concentrate for many of PepsiCo’s mega brands including Gatorade, 7Up and Pepsi. Execute procurement strategies across indirect spend portfolios
Manage indirect category portfolios, delivering commercial value, continuity of supply, and stakeholder requirements, collaborating cross functionally

Deliver productivity, cost savings, and value creation initiatives. Consolidate global savings and pipeline for AOP
Monitor market trends and supplier capabilities to identify risks and opportunities
Provide spend analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and procurement insights to support decision-making
Monitor supplier cost movements and translate market intelligence into commercial recommendations
Influence budget owners and cross-functional stakeholders to support commercially sound decision
Champion procurement policies, GCS controls, compliance requirements, and best practices across the Cork locations and develop an Indirect community to share best practices and learnings with other PGCS indirect buyers across the globe
GPL for Ariba My Buy embedding the system and processes as well as developing strategy for next phase and optimisation of the solution

Degree in Finance, Business Information Systems, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related discipline
5+ years in a multi-national environment
Knowledge of procurement processes and activities including sourcing, category management, spend base and tools, preferably in a fast-moving food & beverage or manufacturing environment. Ideally experienced in categories such as professional services, IT, MRO, HR/recruitment, energy and other operational services
Proven experience defining, implementing or influencing digital strategies in a complex business environment
Strong understanding and experience of governance, process optimisation, business transformation and change management
Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into practical solutions
Highly effective interpersonal, communication and influencing skills across all organisational levels, including executive stakeholders; ability to translate complex topics into clear, concise executive-level communication
Ability to build credible relationships with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, IT senior stakeholders
High level of business acumen, with strong understanding of value drivers, cost drivers, risk, service and operational performance.
Strong analytical skills and ability to use data to identify opportunities, frame decisions and track value delivery
Organisationally savvy, with the confidence to navigate ambiguity, influence without direct authority and drive progress in a matrix organisation
Strong systems experience, preferably SAP, power-point, excel with a natural curiosity in AI

jobs.title: Practitioner Spiritual & Psychological Care
jobs.desc:
Pastoral Care at Marymount University Hospital & Hospice seeks to address the emotional and spiritual needs of palliative care patients and their families as part of the organisation’s holistic approach to care. Pastoral Care services also extend to staff who care for palliative and elderly care patients, supporting them to give of their best in line with Marymount’s Mission, Philosophy, and Ethical Code.
While rooted in the Catholic origins of the hospital, this Ethical Code recognises and respects the increasing diversity of society and is committed to meeting the needs of individuals of all religious denominations, spiritual traditions, and of none.
The Pastoral Care Member will be an active contributor within a small, highly professional team, accompanying patients and families through times of suffering, upheaval, bereavement, and change, and offering comfort and inner healing through presence, conversation, or sacramental ministry. The role may also support Marymount staff during periods of work-related stress or personal difficulty.
Principal Duties And Responsibilities
Clinical and Pastoral Care
In this role, the successful candidate will:
Contribute to multidisciplinary meetings, care planning, and the delivery of care, with particular focus on the spiritual dimension of care, maintaining effective communication and positive working relationships with the multidisciplinary team.
Ensure the appropriate conduct of bereavement ceremonies, sacramental liturgies, and religious and spiritual services to a high professional standard.
Provide appropriate opportunities for emotional support, reflection, prayer, and professional counselling, in line with individual needs and wishes.
Maintain awareness of current ethical issues in healthcare and engage constructively with hospital leadership where ethical matters arise.
Respond to requests from staff for emotional, spiritual, and religious support, including facilitating access to professional supervision, the Employee Assistance Programme, and staff wellbeing initiatives (e.g. prayer, mindfulness, yoga).
Respond to internal or external events affecting patients or staff where a collective response or ritual may be appropriate.
Take responsibility for the Ministry of the Eucharist and sacristy.
Ensure that any religious or spiritual service providers not accredited by the Hospital receive prior approval.
Promote and maintain best practice within the Pastoral Care service to ensure consistent quality of care.
Patient and Family Support
The successful candidate will also:
Ensure patients and families are visited in a timely manner following admission, with visits tailored to identified needs.
Conduct emotional, spiritual, and religious needs assessments professionally, respecting patient and family preferences regarding ongoing contact.
Provide direct pastoral care in line with individual wishes, with particular competence in supporting loss, grief, and bereavement.
Liaise with patients’ own ministers of religion or spiritual advisors, where appropriate.
Participate in the Hospital’s on-call service via the pager system, in line with duty arrangements. Pastoral Care services are offered to all patients and families in a manner respectful of faith, culture, and belief.
Teamwork and Collaboration
In relation to teamwork, the candidate will:
Communicate effectively as a member of the Pastoral Care and wider multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrate understanding of roles, responsibilities, and group dynamics within professional team structures.
Respect diversity and deal constructively with conflict to ensure service-user-focused care.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of a positive and supportive team culture.
Professional Commitment and Governance
In relation to professional and organisational responsibilities, the candidate will:
Demonstrate a commitment to continuous professional development through training and engagement with relevant professional bodies.
Uphold the Hospital’s professional codes of conduct and engage with the Mission Committee as required.
Uphold Marymount’s values to an exemplary level in character and practice.
Develop relevant competencies aligned with the Palliative Care Competence Framework.
Participate in research, education, audit, and training activities, including induction and mission training for new staff.
Ensure compliance with mandatory training requirements and relevant hospital policies.
Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all patient, family, staff, and hospital information.
Engage in external professional supervision as appropriate and support education planning for team members.
Planning and Organisation
In relation to planning and organisation, the candidate will:
Plan and deliver the duties of the role effectively within a person-centred care framework.
Comply with all record-keeping and reporting requirements to an excellent standard.
Manage competing priorities, multitask appropriately, and work within structured systems.
Anticipate challenges and take preventative action where possible.
Demonstrate flexibility, adaptability, and openness to change in a busy healthcare environment.
While the above outlines the core duties of the role, it is not exhaustive. The role will evolve in response to service needs, organisational priorities, and the changing context of care, and the post holder will be expected to undertake additional duties consistent with the nature and level of the role.
Candidates must, on the latest date for receipt of completed applications:
Meet one of the following qualification requirements:
Have successfully completed Clinical Pastoral Education (minimum of three units); or
Hold a professionally recognised pastoral care or chaplaincy qualification; or
Hold an accredited counselling or psychotherapy qualification; and
Have a minimum of two years’ post-qualification professional experience.
Possess the requisite knowledge, skills, and suitability for the proper discharge of the role, including a well-developed understanding of the spiritual, religious, ethical, and psychological issues experienced by patients with life-limiting illness and their families.
Demonstrate excellent teamwork skills, with experience in fostering a culture of welcome and inclusion for people of all faiths and of none.
Demonstrate personal maturity, empathy, sensitivity, integrity, and resilience, together with appropriate levels of emotional and spiritual intelligence.
A clearly articulated philosophy of pastoral care, with insight into professional competencies, boundaries, and self-care.
Desirable Qualifications And / Or Experience
Demonstrated experience in pastoral care within a healthcare or palliative care setting, including bereavement support.
A sound understanding of palliative care principles, including the integration of spiritual, emotional, ethical, and psychosocial dimensions of care.
Knowledge of diverse religious, spiritual, and philosophical traditions, and the ability to work inclusively with patients and families of all faiths and none.
Experience of collaborative practice within multidisciplinary teams, with an interest in education, reflective practice, and relevant research.
Please note this is a permanent part-time position consisting of 28 hours per week.

Excellent communication and client facing skills, with the ability to influence, advise and lead
Experience managing complex projects and contributing to business development, proposals or work-winning activities
A collaborative mindset and passion for advancing high-quality ecological outcomes across Ireland’s growing infrastructure landscape

Experience working on infrastructure, energy, water or transport projects
Experience of protective species licencing and biodiversity enhancements
Stakeholder engagement
But beyond experience, what really matters is your ability to think differently, challenge the status quo, and spot opportunities to improve how we deliver for our clients.

defined company contribution pension scheme;
life assurance and income protection scheme
reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships;

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
The main duties and responsibilities of the Civil Project Manager are outlined as follows:
Ensure HSE & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are always adhered to on-site.
Work closely and collaborate with all key stakeholders including clients, client representatives and third-party agencies.
Ensure a positive experience for the client and their representatives instilling an ethos of collaboration and cooperation.
Lead the construction team in all aspects of the Civil Engineering and Building scope of works.
Liaise closely and support other engineering disciplines including mechanical, electrical and process engineering.
Facilitate the co-ordination role of the PSDP for live projects with internal and external designers. Represent the company as PSCS on live sites within your remit and co-ordinate all required documentation to be present on-site and up to date.

Ensure best practice project management techniques are used such as Lean Construction and Last Planner.

Manage cashflow on projects and work with the Contracts Manager/ Commercial Manager to ensure interim payment applications are submitted on-time to the client.

Full Driving License.

jobs.desc:
Windows Audio Software Engineer
12 Month Contract, Onsite, Cork
About the Company
My client is a world leading wireless technology innovator. They have an immediate requirement for a skilled e Engineer to join their team to work on designing and building next-generation
on-device Voice AI
capabilities.
About the Position
This role is a part of a team working on low-power “always-on” sensing through interactive speech experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, DSP, systems, ML, and product) and work with global stakeholders across regions and sites to deliver robust, production-ready solutions. .
Responsibilities
Own feature development end-to-end for Voice AI capabilities on Windows, including wake-on-voice, on-device ASR, translation, transcription, and TTS.
Gather and refine technical requirements with internal and external partners; translate product goals into clear engineering requirements, architecture, and milestones.
Co-design and implement Windows audio + driver stack solutions that leverage SoC CPU/DSP/NPU capabilities while meeting strict latency and power targets for Voice AI experiences.
Build or extend components across user-mode and kernel-mode boundaries (UMDF/KMDF), integrating with Windows audio frameworks and platform services as needed for Voice AI pipelines.
Drive low-power audio architecture for “always-on” use cases, including concurrency and power-mode transitions across multiple audio features.
Optimize and validate performance using Windows diagnostics and systematically debug complex multi-threaded and multi-processor issues across HW/SW boundaries.
Communicate development status, risks, and mitigations to technical leads and stakeholders.
Participate in roadmap planning and execution; contribute to process improvements that increase quality, scalability, and maintainability.
Experience
4-8 years of industry experience in software engineering, with a focus in one or more of the following areas: Windows system software, device drivers, multimedia/audio, platform software, or performance/power-sensitive products.
Proficiency in systems programming (C/C++ preferred) and ability to deliver production-quality code in complex codebases.
Strong Windows development skills using Visual Studio, source control (Git-based workflows), and disciplined debugging practices.
Solid understanding of Windows OS fundamentals relevant to system-level development: processes/threads, synchronization primitives, memory, I/O, and performance diagnostics.
Experience developing or integrating Windows drivers using KMDF and/or UMDF, including build, deployment, and debugging fundamentals.
Hands-on experience with multi-threaded programming, concurrency control, and performance/latency tuning.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively with distributed teams across regions/time zones.
Preferred Qualifications
Windows audio ecosystem experience (any of the following): audio drivers, audio endpoints, WASAPI, audio effects/APOs, audio policy, power-aware audio scenarios, or end-to-end audio pipeline integration.
Demonstrated experience using
AI-assisted development tools
to improve productivity across the software lifecycle (requirements/architecture, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation), with the ability to
iterate on prompts
and validate outputs against real code and requirements.
Familiarity with mainstream AI coding assistants (e.g.,
GitHub Copilot / Microsoft Copilot
) applied to practical engineering tasks such as code comprehension, change drafting, test scaffolding ideas, and documentation—while maintaining strong review and correctness discipline.
Ability to create and share
repeatable prompt patterns/templates
for common engineering workflows and continuously refine prompts to increase specificity and accuracy.
Experience with
low-power / always-on audio
and power-state transitions (e.g., Modern Standby constraints and wake/trigger flows).
Familiarity with on-device voice activation building blocks and staged verification concepts (e.g., multi-stage keyword/wake approaches).
Experience optimizing workloads across heterogeneous compute (
CPU + DSP + NPU
) and understanding tradeoffs across
latency vs. power vs. quality
.
Exposure to Voice AI pipelines: ASR/TTS, speech translation, transcription, streaming/buffering strategies, and real-time constraints.

Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.

Strong rate between 300-400 per day as well as high likelihood of extension.

.

jobs.title: Renewable Energy Analyst (Graduate)
jobs.desc:
Renewable Energy Analyst (Graduate)
Location:
Cork (hybrid)
Salary:
€45,000 - €55,000, depending on experience
Type:
Full-time, permanent
About us
We are a clean energy company that develops, builds, owns and operates renewable projects across the island of Ireland, with a portfolio spanning onshore wind, solar and battery energy storage (BESS). From our Cork office, our team supports projects across Munster and the wider island, in one of Europe's most exciting renewable energy markets. We are looking for a graduate analyst to help power that growth.
What you will do
You will work at the analytical heart of the business, supporting decisions across development, finance and operations. Expect variety, real responsibility and plenty of learning. Your work will include:
Building and maintaining models for project economics, energy production and market analysis
Conducting research on markets, policy, technologies and competitors to support strategic decisions
Supporting due diligence on new projects and acquisitions, working with data from every corner of the business
Analysing performance data from our operating fleet and reporting on trends and improvements
Preparing clear reports, dashboards and presentations for project teams and senior leadership
Supporting the development team with data for grid applications, planning and site selection
Improving the spreadsheets, tools and datasets the whole company relies on
What we are looking for
A degree (2.1 or above) in finance, economics, engineering, environmental science, data analytics or a related field
A genuine interest in renewable energy and the clean energy transition
Strong analytical skills and real comfort in Excel; experience with Python, SQL or data visualisation tools is an advantage
Attention to detail and the discipline to get the numbers right
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn analysis into insight
Initiative and curiosity: you take ownership, ask good questions and learn quickly
The right to work in Ireland
Internship or project experience in energy, finance or data analysis is an advantage but not essential. We hire for aptitude and attitude, and we invest in developing our people.
What we offer
€45,000 - €55,000 starting salary, depending on experience
Hybrid working from our Cork office
A structured development path with mentorship from experienced analysts and managers
Exposure to development, finance and operations across three technologies
Pension contributions, generous annual leave and wellbeing support
Support for professional development and further study
The chance to grow with a company building and operating real clean energy assets
How to apply
Apply with your CV and a short note on why this role interests you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are available on request at any stage of the recruitment process.

Company Description
Work with Us. Change the World.
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. Job Description
Are you ready to shape the future of energy infrastructure and be at the heart of a varied portfolio of groundbreaking projects? After an exciting period of growth, we are looking to hire an experienced and ambitious Associate Director who can be based in either the UK or Ireland.
As Associate Director, you will be leading end-to-end HV substation design, shaping grid-scale power infrastructure from concept through to energisation on projects that few engineers get the opportunity to be involved in. Your work will be varied, and you’ll be using your expertise to contribute to the success of major projects such as;
National Grid’s ‘Great Grid Upgrade’ Great Grid Partnership: Enabling the UK’s energy transition
Working with the world’s leading Hyperscalers and Data Centre Operators on forward-thinking, revolutionary projects.
EirGrid AECOM appointed to EirGrid engineering design, planning and project management services framework
Start here. Grow here.
Here’s what you’ll do:
Lead HV substation technical discussions with clients and multi-disciplinary teams - establishing scopes, defining interfaces between HV infrastructure and ensuring coordinated delivery.
Direct the technical delivery of substation design major projects, agreeing approach with engineering teams, monitoring progress, and quality-checking deliverables prior to client issue.
Apply lifecycle expertise - from grid connection studies and concept design through FEED and detailed design in order to deliver HV substation schemes that meet the power density and availability.
Liaise with project management teams to develop resourcing forecasts and programmes aligned to construction schedules and critical path milestones
Demonstrate commercial awareness through proposal development, project cost monitoring, and identifying opportunities to expand HV scope on frameworks.
Build trusted relationships with cleints, understanding their grid connection strategies and availability requirements.
Champion safety in design principles across all HV substation deliverables, ensuring compliance with relevant standards and the specific operational safety requirements.
Mentor and develop junior engineers, building team capability in HV substation design over the medium and long term.
Enjoy the Perks.
At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.
Qualifications
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s what we’re looking for:
Previous experience with consultancy, contractor, or utility in the energy sector. Client experience with National Grid, SHET, SSE, SPT or any other transmission utility or developer in UK or Ireland
Proven experience delivering HV infrastructure design at concept, FEED, and detailed design stages.
Strong understanding of electrical AC HV plant and equipment — both AIS and GIS — including switchgear, busbars, cabling, earthing, and civil interfaces
Working knowledge of National Grid standards and specifications
Proposal and bid development experience, including leading multi-discipline submissions for Data Centre, HV infrastructure or grid connection projects
Experience of design management and site construction review; primary plant focus is essential, with secondary systems knowledge (protection, control, SCADA) advantageous.
Familiarity with Control systems, transformers, HVDC systems, interconnectors, HV Protection & Control knowledge and experience would be advantageous
Ideally CDAE / LCDAE approval
We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at ReasonableAccommodations@aecom.com. At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.
If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!
Additional Information
Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. Job Description
The opportunity:
Join Grant Thornton's Global Compliance and Reporting Services (GCRS) team and build your career in an international, client-focused environment. As an Assistant Manager, you will work closely with experienced managers and senior colleagues, as well as finance professionals in publicly listed companies and multinational organisations.
You will support clients as they respond to increasingly complex and geographically diverse accounting and reporting requirements. Working within our Financial Accounting and Advisory Services (FAAS) team, you will use your Spanish GAAP expertise to deliver practical solutions, contribute to high-quality financial reporting and develop your experience through challenging international engagements.
This cross-sector role is suited to candidates from either industry or a professional practice environment who are keen to broaden their technical expertise, strengthen their client relationships and gain exposure to multinational organisations.
What you will do:
Deliver international compliance engagements, with a particular focus on Spanish GAAP accounting and both direct and indirect tax requirements;
Apply your Spanish GAAP expertise to convert US GAAP or IFRS trial balances and prepare financial statements that meet applicable Spanish statutory, tax and financial reporting requirements
Take ownership of financial statement preparation under Spanish GAAP and other relevant accounting frameworks, completing thorough self-reviews to maintain quality and accuracy;
Develop technical accounting papers and design and deliver training on Spanish GAAP and country-specific requirements for clients and colleagues, keep your technical knowledge current by monitoring international accounting and tax developments, particularly those relevant to Spanish GAAP;
Collaborate with clients and Grant Thornton colleagues across EMEA, APAC and the Americas, building a strong international network;
Manage your assignments effectively to meet agreed budgets, timelines and statutory filing deadlines;
Contribute positively to a collaborative team environment and take a proactive approach to solving client challenges;
Support and mentor junior colleagues, sharing knowledge and supporting their development; and,
Help strengthen key client relationships, both locally and internationally.
Why Grant Thornton and GCRS:
You will join a collaborative, growing team where you can deepen your Spanish GAAP expertise, work on varied international engagements and build relationships across the Grant Thornton network. You will gain exposure to multinational clients, learn from experienced colleagues and contribute to the continued development of our global compliance and reporting services team.
What you will bring:
A recognised accountancy qualification and strong Spanish GAAP knowledge, ideally supported by one to two years of relevant experience; ACA or ACCA qualifications combined with equivalent Spanish GAAP expertise are also welcome;
Strong hands-on experience preparing and reviewing Spanish GAAP financial statements, ranging from straightforward to complex sets of accounts;
Relevant experience gained within a top 20 accountancy firm;
Strong communication skills and fluency in Spanish and English; proficiency in another European language would be an advantage but is not essential;
Working knowledge of ONESOURCE for accounts preparation would be beneficial;
Experience working with multinational organisations would be advantageous but is not essential; this may have been gained in either industry or a professional practice environment;
The ability to manage competing priorities, work to tight timelines and meet statutory filing deadlines;
Strong commercial awareness and an interest in understanding clients' businesses;
A self-motivated, collaborative approach and a growth mindset; and
A genuine commitment to delivering an excellent client experience.
An interest in how AI can transform the future of accounting.
About Us
We are Grant Thornton
Grant Thornton Ireland is rapidly approaching 3,000 people, in 9 offices across Ireland, Isle of Man, Gibraltar and Bermuda. With a presence in over 149 countries around the world and a global network of 73,000 people, we bring our clients the local knowledge, national expertise and global presence to help them succeed – wherever they’re located.
At GT, we work as
trusted advisors
, bringing local knowledge and national expertise, with a global presence, to help businesses succeed – wherever they are located. We make business more personal by investing in building relationships and empowering our clients to make the right decisions for their organisation now and for the future. Whether that is working with the public sector to build thriving communities, with regulators and financial institutions to build trust, or with a diverse range of businesses to help them achieve their goals, Grant Thornton Ireland work hard to support clients to act on the issues that matter.
At GT Ireland we don’t just predict your future, we build it
.
A Career at GT
Looking for a more fulfilling role in professional services? One where fresh thinking, collaboration and diversity are valued? At Grant Thornton we do things differently.
What does this mean for you?
A career in a more inclusive working environment, a more collaborative work culture, a more supported, flexible working role, more possibilities to grow and more opportunities to help shape the future for your clients. We respect and value your experience. And we want you to bring your authentic self to work and be at your best. It is how it should be.
Grow with us
At Grant Thornton, we care about our people and work hard to make you feel valued. If you are looking to deepen and develop your skills, knowledge, and experience throughout your career, then that is what you will get, and more.
Our Benefits
Please follow this link for information on our generous benefits package.
About The Team
Equity, diversity and inclusion
At Grant Thornton, we provide equitable opportunities for all our colleagues. We are a responsible, sustainable business where equity, diversity and inclusion (ED&I) is at the forefront of our workplace culture agenda, and today, we continue to build and develop on our existing ED&I structure and strategy to meet our workplace culture needs. People are at the heart of our business and teams built with varied individuals present diverse viewpoints, which need to be heard and valued.
We are all at our best when we are able to be ourselves and we view integrity and authenticity as integral values to bring to our day-to-day work-life at the firm. We are excited to see the personality and perspectives you will bring to our team because we know we will all benefit from them. Diversity of thought, background and experience enables better decision-making, improves the quality of our delivery, and helps us to meet the needs of our clients. Our firm is built on people and their ideas, so we want to hear all the new perspectives and fresh thinking you have to offer. You form the bedrock of our firm’s best-practice principles and we will champion you as leaders from day one.
Reward And Benefits
Our reward and benefits are designed to create an environment where our people can flourish. We are committed to building a culture where our people have access to the necessary benefits to help promote a healthy lifestyle and thrive.
Recognition
We want to create a culture of recognition and celebrating success, by saying thank you to people who surpass our expectations and recognising the right values and behaviours. Our Shout Out recognition scheme is our way of highlighting and promoting achievements. Whether you simply want to say thank you, celebrate a special occasion or give an award for doing something exceptional, you can do all of this and more through the scheme.

jobs.title: Festival & Events Manager
jobs.desc:
Meitheal Mara, Cork’s community boatyard and maritime training centre, invites applications for the position of Festival & Events Manager for the annual Ocean to City – An Rás Mór and Cork Harbour Festival. The position is for the equivalent of 32 hours per week, with an annual salary of €34,212. Flexibility with be required in the annual distribution of hours, with a higher proportion worked during the periods leading up to events.
The role is based at Meitheal Mara’s offices at Crosses Green House, Cork and is offered on a contract of indefinite duration, subject to continued funding.
Cork Harbour Festival
Cork Harbour Festival is the largest annual event in Cork Harbour offering a 10-day celebration of Ireland’s maritime culture. The festival features over 100 different events, organised by 50+ cultural, community, sporting and maritime event partners across Cork City and County.
The festival is coordinated and promoted by Meitheal Mara, attracting approximately 30,000 visitors annually. Funded by Fáilte Ireland, Cork City Council, Cork County Council and the Port of Cork, the festival provides an important platform for Meitheal Mara’s wider work: celebrating Ireland’s maritime culture, connecting people with our waterways and creating opportunities to participate on the water.
Ocean to City – An Rás Mór
Ocean to City – An Rás Mór is the flagship event of Cork Harbour Festival and the largest event directly organised and delivered by Meitheal Mara. It is Ireland’s largest multi-craft rowing and paddling race, attracting 600+ participants annually – of which a third are international.
The Festival & Events Manager will have overall responsibility for the planning and delivery of the Ocean to City race, from initial planning, stakeholder engagement and participant promotion through to event delivery, evaluation and reporting.
The Festival & Events Manager
The successful candidate will coordinate all aspects of Ocean to City –An Rás Mór, working closely with Meitheal Mara staff, volunteers, participants, partners, sponsors, suppliers, agencies, funders and other stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of a safe, inclusive and well-managed event.
The role also oversees Meitheal Mara’s coordination of Cork Harbour Festival, with overall responsibility for the successful delivery of the programme. The Festival Manager will support and line-manage the Marketing, PR & Programme Coordinator, who will focus on festival programming, event partner liaison, marketing and communications.
The role will also coordinate and deliver Meitheal Mara’s Dragon Boat Challenge corporate fundraiser, held at regular times throughout the year.
The successful candidate will have strong event management experience coupled with experience in managing and coordinating a mixed team of staff and volunteers in a community setting.
Main duties:
Work with the Ocean to City Director, the Race Operations Task Group (Volunteer Team Leaders), the Operations Manager of Meitheal Mara and other staff members to ensure the delivery, operation and sustainability of Ocean to City and Cork Harbour Festival.
Maintain and develop relationships with existing funders.
Work collaboratively with existing event partners to promote and manage the event; identify new partners and build relationships.
Provide line management to all Events Office staff.
Budget management, assist with forecasting and ensure that sponsorship, income and expenditure falls within targets.
Monitor and analyse event performance and effectiveness.
Prepare post-event reports for programme funders and the Meitheal Mara Board.
Provide assistance with other Meitheal Mara activities as required.
The ideal candidate will have:
Significant experience working in event management, ideally in the cultural, community and voluntary sector.
Relevant qualifications.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
Strong IT and social media skills.
Experience in marketing and PR.
Ability to work well under pressure, multi-task and meet deadlines.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to deal calmly and effectively with the unexpected.
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment.
Ability and flexibility to work overtime and alternate shifts as job needs require.
Experience of budget management and meeting income and expenditure targets.
Experience of meeting funder requirements and preparing funder reports.
Experience or understanding of maritime and/or sporting events and activities would be an advantage.
Hands-on team leadership skills with line management experience.
A strong commitment to the community development ethos of Meitheal Mara.
Applications

Closing date for applications:
Midnight on Sunday 18 October 2026
Interviews for those successfully shortlisted will be held in the week 26-30 October. The ideal start date is mid-November 2026.

Stock magician: You tackle the puzzle of sorting, pricing, merchandising and managing deliveries like Santa’s little helper! Embrace the boxes; they’ve got nothing on you!

To inspire reading, learning, creativity and play 💛💙
Our Values
We are
Crafty 🎨

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer (PRAMS)
jobs.desc:
Around the world, SYSTRA’s specialists plan, design, integrate, test, commission, project manage and deliver mass transit and mobility solutions that are relied on by more than 50 million people every day.
For more than 60 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their transport infrastructure with sustainability, accessibility and innovation at the heart of our designs. With over 10,300 colleagues globally and around 1000 in the UK & Ireland we are growing significantly and seeking out the very best talent to join the SYSTRA signature team and be part of leading the way in infrastructure design.
Context
Our Systems Engineering and Assurance discipline includes leading experts in Systems Engineering, System Safety, Cybersecurity, Software Assurance, Human Factors/Ergonomics and PRAM. We wish to further expand this capability through augmenting our current PRAM capability to include further expertise in PRAM engineering analysis techniques and the application on UK mainline and metro projects.
The role of Principal Engineer (Performance, Reliability, Availability and Maintainability) within the Systems Engineering & Assurance discipline will be key to enabling this capability growth. Individuals interested in such a role require a strong foundation in Performance and Reliability analysis and the development of reliability cases, ideally within the transportation industry.
Missions/Main Duties
The Role Will Be Varied And Primarily Comprise Of
Developing effective strategies to ensure the reliability, availability and maintainability of products, systems and applications as required by our clients (Including Network Rail, LU, Heathrow Airport, HS1, HS2 and similar overseas organisations).
Defining and analysing performance and reliability requirements relating to the mainline and metro rail projects.
Carrying out PRAM requirements capture, analysis, modelling, prediction and demonstration of designs including managing interfaces in relation to PRAM matters.
Monitoring system design and implementation to produce PRAM analysis material that provides sufficient evidence to demonstrate that the system has been developed and configured to meet the PRAM requirements throughout the whole lifetime of the System of Interest.
Developing PRAM arguments and Performance/Reliability/Maintainability cases in line with current best practice, including relevant legislation, standards (e.g. CENELEC 50126/50128/50129, the Common Safety Method (CSM), NTSNs etc.) to gain railway authority approval
Reviewing Performance, Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety (PRAM) deliverables to verify that the design will meet the requirements and adhering to the processes established for the successful delivery of a project/solution.
To define and implement a concise and auditable ‘One Systra approach’ approach for the identification of PRAM requirements, their implementation, and the demonstration of compliance with those requirements
Guiding others in implementing the PRAMS processes, strategy and requirements through working closely and upskilling peers within the Systems Engineering and Assurance discipline.
Profile/Skills
Essential Requirements For The Role Include
The suitable candidate will have proven and broad ranging experience coupled with commercial acumen and a desire to lead the development of this capability within an established design consultancy. Thus, we are looking for someone with the following knowledge and experience:
Understanding and application experience of PRAM management and PRAM engineering processes such as PRAM planning, PRAM analysis, PRAM requirements capture, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMECA), FRACAS and production of PRAM Demonstration reports

About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. Are you looking to work for a company that is Ahead of What’s Possible…. a company where you are empowered to Act with Courage, to Build great teams, to Create the future, and to Drive for Excellence? If so, then Analog Devices International (ADI) is the place for you.
Leading Edge Technology;
From digital healthcare to 5G connectivity, from autonomous and electric vehicles to the digitised factory, Analog Devices is passionate about turning tomorrow's possibilities into reality, making the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener. Wherever digital meets physical we’re there. Virtually every wireless call, text, and download today passes through an Analog Devices IC. Ahead of What’s Possible
.

Software development at ADI spans from edge nodes to generating insights in the cloud – and everything in between. Working with hardware teams, your software skills in planning, systems architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, debugging, and testing can help to unlock the potential of our algorithms, technology platforms, and systems to make a real-world impact. Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include; IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure. As ADI continues to grow its software capability we’re also focussed on building expertise in the area of Machine Learning and AI. We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real.

jobs.title: Graduate Electrical Engineer APM
jobs.desc:
Application Closing Date: 30th October 2026 - Please note we reserve the right to close roles sooner, so Early Application is encouraged.
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
Role description:
Our two-year Graduate GROW Programme supports your transition from student to professional, sitting along client work and real projects from day one. Each graduate’s journey is unique, shaped by their chosen specialism and the variety of projects they contribute to. You will build your technical expertise by contributing to meaningful client engagements and project work, whilst business acumen and professional skills will be developed through centrally delivered graduate cohort training. Although there are no formal rotations, graduates are encouraged and supported by their managers to proactively seek opportunities, to broaden their experience and support their development.
As an engineer joining GROW, you will be given the opportunity to specialise within your chosen discipline of engineering and we ensure you obtain the appropriate experiences that you need to become a technical expert. Being an Engineer at Arcadis is about applying a human filter to all your technical expertise and training, and making an impact through innovation and creativity. During this two-year programme you will develop core engineering and consulting techniques that can be applied while working with our clients in the UK&I and potentially even some of our international clients around the globe.
Role accountabilities:
Joining a multidisciplinary team, you will support our clients with their project needs covering aspects such as architectural, process, HVAC, mechanical, electrical, commissioning, validation, and construction management services, across the industrial and pharmaceutical sectors. The design work will include electrical power, instrumentation, and building services across a range of pharmaceutical and industrial projects. You will be involved in the design and development of schematic diagrams and protection schemes for site electrical power distribution equipment and systems as well as creating semi-conductor tool install design packages, maintaining utility services matrix and/or databases and carry out design calculations for cable-sizing, short circuit calculations, lighting calculations, power balance studying, and arc flash for all electrical systems.
Accepted degrees: Level 7 Electrical Engineering and above
Qualifications & Experience:
You will be graduating in 2027 or have recently graduated in 2025 or 2026, with at least a 2:2 in a relevant master's or bachelor's degree
You will demonstrate typical Arcadian skills including Resilience, Creativity, Analytical Thinking and being a Team Player
You will have excellent communication skills and the ability to use your technical knowledge to influence and consult stakeholders.

Role:
Junior Civil Engineer
Location Base:
Lisgoold Wwtp Co.Cork
Salary:
Competitive Salary and Commercial
The Role
As a Civil Junior Engineer, you will work as part of our multi-disciplinary engineering team to bring water and wastewater projects from initial design right through to completion and handover to the client. You will have the opportunity to work alongside and learn from, industry-leading project teams, working in a one-team culture while broadening your own skill set. As a Civil Junior Engineer, you will demonstrate a willingness to learn and engage as part of an experienced delivery team involved in the delivery of multi-disciplinary projects. You will be expected to support senior staff in the daily operation and delivery of projects as well as showing progression and development within your own career. Due to the nature of the works completed by Glanua you will have an opportunity to witness a wide variety of multi-disciplinary engineering activities and will have the opportunity to grow and develop a specialised knowledge base, and develop your career in a variety of areas of project delivery from design and pricing, right through to delivery and operations.
Main Duties And Responsibilities
The main duties and responsibilities of the Civil Junior Engineer are outlined as follows:
Work as part of a team in the delivery of one or more projects at any one time, embracing the ethos of a “one team” culture.
Ensure Health, Safety, Environmental & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are always adhered to on-site.
Assisting site teams with survey set out and as build capturing through the use of GPS, total station and 3D scanning.
Review designs and develop solutions for design-based issues. Witness design from conception through to physical delivery on site
Liaise and engage with direct delivery staff, subcontractors, suppliers, client staff, statutory bodies and members of the public
Complete take off’s and manage the procurement process of materials for delivery to site.
Follow-up with suppliers on delivery dates, ensuring timely delivery in line with programme dates.
Keep appraised of the latest standards and technology through continuous professional development (CPD).
Assist with the completion of health and safety requirements on site inclusive of inductions, statutory inspections, record keeping and data collection.
Show an eagerness to learn and progress in your own career. Glanua has a proven track record of developing graduates from graduation through to becoming directors within the organisation.
Other duties as required from time to time.
Knowledge, Skills And Experience
The main knowledge, skills and experience required of the Civil Junior Engineer are outlined as follows:
Degree in Civil Engineering
An interest in developing a career within an industry-leading organisation.
Ability to work as part of a team in project delivery and provide input at team meetings.
Ability to engage with suppliers and sub-contractors at procurement stage and in delivery of their scope of supply during contract delivery.
Ability to use own initiative, problem solve and adjust as issues arise during project delivery.
Good working knowledge of MS packages such as Word, Excel and Powerpoint.
Strong communications skills with a high level of motivation.
Full driving licence
What we offer you:
The opportunity to join an ambitious and growing organisation.
Monday to Friday working week finishing early on Fridays.
23 days annual leave plus 10 bank holidays.
Competitive base salary.
A company laptop and phone.
Access to EAP – 24/7 365 days confidential employee counselling service, free to avail for employees and their families.

jobs.title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote - Germany | UK | Ireland)
jobs.desc:
Build analytics people can trust. Help define what analytics looks like in an AI-first world.
Most analytics platforms ask organisations to trade control for insight.
For almost 20 years, Matomo has shown there is another way: powerful, transparent and trustworthy analytics that respects privacy, gives organisations ownership of their data, and helps people understand what's happening, make better decisions, and improve their work.
More than one million websites use Matomo. That means you'll work on software that is widely used, technically demanding, and close enough to customers that your work has a visible impact. It's a rare opportunity for engineers: solving meaningful, complex product problems while seeing the difference your work makes for customers.
We are independent, profitable, and open source. We are not trying to become a smaller copy of Big Tech analytics platforms. We are building a different kind of analytics company: one where privacy, transparency, customer control, and product quality are part of the core product, not marketing claims.
This role focuses on Matomo Core, the foundation of our product and the platform our open-source users, cloud customers, and wider plugin ecosystem depend on.
If you want
unusually high ownership, visible impact, hard product & platform problems, and the opportunity to strengthen a widely used open-source platform
, Matomo is worth a serious look.
Why this role matters
Matomo Core is the foundation of our open-source product, cloud platform, plugins, integrations and customer-facing features.
It has evolved over many years and operates across a wide range of environments, use cases and data volumes. Every improvement to Core benefits customers, open-source users, plugin developers and engineering teams across the Matomo ecosystem.
We are bringing responsibility for Core into a newly formed European team. You'll help shape how this team works, where it focuses and how it creates the greatest impact across Matomo.
As a Product Engineer, you’ll help decide where Core can create the greatest impact. That could mean solving a difficult customer problem, strengthening an existing capability, creating a new platform capability, or simplifying the Core platform to make it easier to evolve.
You’ll work on a mature and technically complex product. The challenge is not simply to preserve what exists. It is to understand why it exists, recognise where it is holding customers or engineers back, and evolve it without disrupting the open-source users, customers, integrations and plugins that already depend on it.
What you’ll own
You'll own problems, not just code.
This is not a traditional feature-ticket engineering role. You'll understand customer problems, shape solutions, build across the stack, ship incrementally and continuously improve what you release. AI should be part of your everyday workflow.
You'll own work from problem to outcome:
Understand the problem before committing to a solution.
Help shape priorities, not just implement them.
Build across the stack wherever the problem takes you.
Ship incrementally and learn from real usage.
Measure outcomes and iterate.
Use AI throughout your workflow.
For senior:
You'll help shape what we build, not only how we build it. You'll identify opportunities others haven't seen, influence technical and product direction, and help establish how the Core team operates as it grows.
For intermediate:
You'll contribute to deciding what we build, working closely with product, engineering and customers rather than simply implementing predefined requirements. You'll own meaningful problems end-to-end while building confidence in navigating ambiguity and product trade-offs.
What The Work Looks Like
You'll work across the Core platform wherever you can create the greatest impact.
Examples include:
Diagnosing and solving complex problems across a large, mature codebase.
Strengthening the security, performance, scalability, reliability and resilience of Matomo.
Protecting the integrity, accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers rely on.
Strengthen capabilities that support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases.
Building and evolving APIs and platform capabilities used by Matomo plugins and integrations.
Evolving how Matomo handles consent, privacy and responsible data collection.
Advancing server-side tracking, data anonymisation and data-health monitoring.
Enhancing analytics capabilities such as goals, ecommerce reporting and dashboards.
Simplifying complex analytics workflows and making powerful functionality easier to use.
Evolving Matomo's design system to create a more consistent and usable product experience.
How we work
We’re a small team competing with companies many times our size.
That means we optimise for impact.
We value:
Customer problems over technical elegance.
Shipping over endless planning.
Simple solutions over unnecessary complexity.
Ownership over handoffs.
Iteration over perfection.
Clear writing over excessive meetings.
Pragmatic engineering over abstract architecture.
AI where it helps us move faster.
Measuring outcomes over assuming we were right.
We care about high standards, but we do not confuse high standards with slow processes. We would rather ship a small useful improvement, learn from it, and improve it than spend months perfecting something before customers see it.
At the same time, changes to Matomo Core can affect a large number of customers, integrations and plugins. You should be able to move pragmatically while recognising when additional investigation, testing or migration planning is necessary.
What we’re looking for
For senior:
You're already operating with a high degree of autonomy. You naturally identify valuable opportunities, make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, and multiply the team's impact through the systems you build, the decisions you influence and the way you approach problems.
For intermediate:
You're already comfortable delivering software independently and are looking to take greater ownership of customer problems, product decisions and technical direction.
You enjoy building products
You get motivated by solving customer problems and delivering value, not by technical novelty alone.
You care whether people actually use and benefit from what you build. Seeing a feature make a real difference is more rewarding to you than building something technically clever that nobody uses.
You naturally ask:
What problem are we solving?
Who has this problem?
Is this the simplest useful solution?
How will we know this made things better?
What should we do if the data shows we were wrong?
You are comfortable with complex, mature systems
You do not need every problem to start with a clean architecture or an empty repository.
You are comfortable tracing behaviour across an unfamiliar codebase, understanding historical constraints, debugging difficult interactions, and making incremental improvements without unnecessary rewrites.
You can balance immediate customer needs with longer-term platform health. You know when to fix the immediate issue, when to address the underlying cause, and when a broader architectural change is justified.
You are comfortable across the stack
You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback.
Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems.
You use AI as part of how you work
We make heavy use of AI-assisted development throughout our engineering workflow.
You should already be using AI tools regularly or be strongly motivated to do so. We expect Product Engineers to use AI to increase output and quality.
AI does not replace your judgment. You remain responsible for product decisions, technical correctness, security, privacy, maintainability,

Job Description
About us
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
About The Function
Sales is where our brands meet the real world.
This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter.
It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.
About The Role
*This is a 12-month Fixed Term contract role*
Location
South West & South East - Galway, Cork, Limerick, Kerry, Waterford & Kilkenny
Do you have the desire to establish and grow the best spirits' portfolio in the world across the most influential on trade venues and groups in Ireland?
Do you want to not only implement great brand plans, but crucially work collaboratively with top customers to develop your own ideas for our brands and bring them to life?
Do you have the skills to delight these customers commercially while still delivering a margin enhancing proposition for Diageo?
Can you create real followership among the people you work with?
Do you generate real trust with people, and they want to collaborate with you?
If you can do these, and if you are up for leading a growth agenda where you will leave a real legacy then this is the role for you.
You will report to the Head of Spirits, with direct responsibility for the spirits portfolio performance in most influential customers and strategic Groups across the On-Trade Channel.
In This Role, You Will
Win sustainable market share of spirits: Grow share of spirits disproportionately.
Win spirits share commercially in the top outlets and groups across Ireland: Build and execute the commercial investment strategy.
Lead the spirits growth plan in key strategic groups through brilliant head office engagement and relationship management.
Be the best partner through amazing engagement and activation: Collaborate with Strategic On-Trade operators to implement programs & develop tailored activity & events. Work alongside and with the current sales team to deliver a seamless customer experience.
Amplify our brands: Collaborate with local and global brand and distillery teams to develop high impact brand projects for the portfolio).
Brand Advocacy: Devise and implement a commercial brand strategy to generate brand love across key on trade influencers and bar tenders in the top venues in Ireland with custom brand training and engagement.
Lead M&E activity to ensure we are constantly improving our plans.
About You

High level spirits knowledge

Analytical and core selling skills
Can build powerful relationships and work collaboratively within a team
Working with Us
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
Contemporary work life balance policies and wellbeing activities
On site gym or subsidised gym membership
Contributary pension scheme
Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family
Annual bonus of circa 20% of your base salary (dependent on performance)
Share options

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

About Citco
JOB DESCRIPTION
The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.
About The Team & Business Line
Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.
Responsibilities
Your Role:
Responsible for the calculation and reporting of hedge funds’ clients NAV’s.
Liaising with clients in relation to trade issues and/or corporate action issues.
Manage daily reconciliation of cash and positions - both listed, unlisted and OTC to Custodian's/Prime Brokers and Counterparty's.
Manage verification of fee accruals in the accounting system in accordance with the PPM and/or agreed Fee Budgets.
Manage capital activity recording in the accounting system.
Manage verification of profit and loss attribution on each NAV.
Manage calculation of performance/incentive fees in the NAV and their respective payment.
Manage analyzing changes in funds’ values in relation to broader market fluctuations.
Responsible for accurate and timely completion of the NAV to the client and third parties in line with the Service Level Agreement and the funds legal documentation.
Liaising with Clients and or Auditors in respect of fund specific queries.
Review funds details/transactions to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
Computing income distributions and reportable yields.
Provide assistance to team members in execution of daily operational activities.
Assisting with the preparation of financial statements and audits as requested.
Fulfill established departmental fund accounting processing procedures, controls and best practice documentation
Meet client, investor and regulatory reporting deliverables and deadlines.
Qualifications
About You:
You have a degree qualification in the field of business, finance and accounting.
Internship / office experience within finance industry desirable.
Able to work in a team and ability to work under pressure.
Our Benefits
Your well being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.
We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.
Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

jobs.title: Global Compliance and Reporting Solutions (French GAAP) - Assistant Manager
jobs.desc:
Job Description
The opportunity:
Join Grant Thornton's Global Compliance and Reporting Services (GCRS) team and build your career in an international, client-focused environment. As an Assistant Manager, you will work closely with experienced managers and senior colleagues, as well as finance professionals in publicly listed companies and multinational organisations.
You will support clients as they respond to increasingly complex and geographically diverse accounting and reporting requirements. Working within our Financial Accounting and Advisory Services (FAAS) team, you will use your French GAAP expertise to deliver practical solutions, contribute to high-quality financial reporting and develop your experience through challenging international engagements.
This cross-sector role is suited to candidates from either industry or a professional practice environment who are keen to broaden their technical expertise, strengthen their client relationships and gain exposure to multinational organisations.
What you will do:
Deliver international compliance engagements, with a particular focus on French GAAP accounting and both direct and indirect tax requirements;
Apply your French GAAP expertise to convert US GAAP or IFRS trial balances and prepare financial statements that meet applicable Spanish statutory, tax and financial reporting requirements
Take ownership of financial statement preparation under French GAAP and other relevant accounting frameworks, completing thorough self-reviews to maintain quality and accuracy;
Develop technical accounting papers and design and deliver training on French GAAP and country-specific requirements for clients and colleagues, keep your technical knowledge current by monitoring international accounting and tax developments, particularly those relevant to French GAAP;
Collaborate with clients and Grant Thornton colleagues across EMEA, APAC and the Americas, building a strong international network;
Manage your assignments effectively to meet agreed budgets, timelines and statutory filing deadlines;
Contribute positively to a collaborative team environment and take a proactive approach to solving client challenges;
Support and mentor junior colleagues, sharing knowledge and supporting their development; and,
Help strengthen key client relationships, both locally and internationally.
Why Grant Thornton and GCRS:
You will join a collaborative, growing team where you can deepen your French GAAP expertise, work on varied international engagements and build relationships across the Grant Thornton network. You will gain exposure to multinational clients, learn from experienced colleagues and contribute to the continued development of our global compliance and reporting services team.
What you will bring:
A recognised accountancy qualification and strong French GAAP knowledge, ideally supported by one to two years of relevant experience; ACA or ACCA qualifications combined with equivalent French GAAP expertise are also welcome;
Strong hands-on experience preparing and reviewing French GAAP financial statements, ranging from straightforward to complex sets of accounts;
Relevant experience gained within a top 20 accountancy firm;
Strong communication skills and fluency in French and English; proficiency in another European language would be an advantage but is not essential;
Working knowledge of ONESOURCE for accounts preparation would be beneficial;
Experience working with multinational organisations would be advantageous but is not essential; this may have been gained in either industry or a professional practice environment;
The ability to manage competing priorities, work to tight timelines and meet statutory filing deadlines;
Strong commercial awareness and an interest in understanding clients' businesses;
A self-motivated, collaborative approach and a growth mindset; and
A genuine commitment to delivering an excellent client experience.

Tesco is a values-led business and we are committed to building a better Tesco and to support our colleagues in Serving Ireland’s Shoppers a Little Better Everyday.
